questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
A man owned land along the south side of a highway. To the south of the man's land was a lot owned by a woman who lived on it in a house.
Five years ago, the man conveyed a right-of-way easement over his land to the woman because it provided a more direct route between her house and the highway. The easement was evidenced by a clearly marked path. The document granting the easement was promptly recorded.
Three years ago, the woman conveyed the house to the man. The man never took actual possession of the house.
Two years ago, the man conveyed the house to a purchaser by a warranty deed. Two months after the purchaser moved into the house, a neighbor informed him about the easement. He then began using the path that had been marked on the man's land. When the man noticed the purchaser using the path, he erected a barricade on his land that effectively prevented the purchaser from using the path.
The purchaser has sued the man, claiming that he has an easement over the man's land.
Who is likely to prevail?

choices.A: The man, because the easement was extinguished.
choices.B: The man, because the purchaser did not have actual notice of the easement at the time of acquisition.
choices.C: The purchaser, because he purchased the house by warranty deed.
choices.D: The purchaser, because the easement was of public record when he acquired the house.

questions.explanation:
Ways to terminate easements
  • Destruction – servient estate condemned or destroyed by natural forces
  • Abandonment – dominant estate abandons easement
  • Merger – dominant & servient estates united in common ownership
  • Prescription – servient owner prevents use for prescriptive period
  • Estoppel – dominant owner estopped from asserting easement
  • Release – express release in writing satisfying statute of frauds

Mnemonic: DAMPER

An easement is extinguished by merger when the dominant estate (ie, land benefited by the easement) and the servient estate (ie, land burdened by the easement) are united in common ownership. Once extinguished, the easement is not revived simply because the land is re-severed into two parcels. Instead, a new easement must be created.

Here, the man conveyed an easement to the woman that allowed her to cross his land to access the highway. The easement was extinguished when the dominant estate (woman's lot) and servient estate (man's land) merged into the hands of one owner after the woman conveyed her house to the man. And it was not revived when the man re-severed the land by conveying the house to the purchaser—regardless of the purchaser's actual or record notice of the prior easement (Choices B & D). Therefore, the purchaser has no easement over the man's land.

(Choice C) The fact that the purchaser acquired the house by warranty deed has no impact on whether the prior easement terminated (or was then revived). But if the man had purported to convey an easement over his land to the purchaser, then the purchaser could have sued the man for breach of warranties under the deed.

📌 Educational Objective

Under the merger doctrine, an easement is terminated if the dominant and servient estates are united in common ownership. The terminated easement is not revived by re-severing the land into two parcels.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Third) of Property: Servitudes § 7.5 (Am. Law Inst. 2000) (termination by merger).
questions.zh-question:
一名男子在一条公路南侧拥有一块土地。该男子土地的南边是一块地，地上一栋房屋为一名女子所有并由其居住。

五年前，该男子向该女子转让了其土地上的一项通行地役权，因为这为她的房屋和公路之间提供了一条更直接的路线。该地役权由一条清晰标记的小路证明。授予地役权的文件被及时登记。

三年前，该女子将房屋转让给了该男子。该男子从未实际占有该房屋。

两年前，该男子通过一份担保契约将房屋转让给了一位买方。买方搬入该房屋两个月后，一位邻居告知了他关于该地役权的事。于是他开始使用该男子土地上标记的小路。当该男子注意到买方在使用小路时，他在自己的土地上设置了一个路障，有效地阻止了买方使用该小路。

买方已起诉该男子，声称其对该男子的土地拥有地役权。

谁可能胜诉？

zh-choices.A: 男子，因为地役权已经消灭。
zh-choices.B: 男子，因为买方在获得所有权时并未实际知晓该地役权的存在。
zh-choices.C: 买方，因为他是通过担保契约购买的房屋。
zh-choices.D: 买方，因为在他获得房屋所有权时，该地役权已有公共记录。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Rights in Real Property - Easements

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：地役权（easement）在主体合并到同一人名下后，是否因并权（merger）而终止，之后再分割也不会自动复活。

三秒认题路径：

先有地役权 → 后同一所有 → 并权终止 → 再分割不复活 → 选无地役权

核心法律规则

地役权（easement，考场意思：别人可以合法穿过你的地）如果让受益地块（dominant estate，考场意思：得好处的那块地）和负担地块（servient estate，考场意思：被压着的那块地）并到同一所有人手里，就会因并权（merger，考场意思：权利和负担不可能同时再“自己管自己”）而终止。Once extinguished 的意思很直接：灭掉了就不会因为后来再切回两块地而自动回来。

所以这题里，女人把房子卖给男人后，男人把受益地和负担地握在同一人手里，原来的地役权已经灭掉。之后男人再把房子卖给买受人，也只是重新分割土地，不是自动重建旧地役权。

核心判例： Restatement (Third) of Property: Servitudes § 7.5 - 并权会终止地役权，终止后不会因重新分割而复活。

思维导图

女人的房子 受益地块
＋
男人的土地 负担地块
→
同一所有人 并权（merger）
→
原地役权终止 不再可主张通行权
→
后来再卖给买受人 重新分割，不复活

考点陷阱

你可能会想：既然地役权当时已经登记，买受人又后来才知道，应该还能照着公示记录主张。

但考试真正问的是：并权后这条地役权早就灭了，后面的实际通知（actual notice）和记录通知（record notice）都救不回一个已经终止的权利。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，不是「地面上看起来有没有那条路」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 A？

题干先出现 女方把房子卖给男方，受益地和负担地已并入同一所有人，原地役权因并权终止，后来再卖给买受人也不会自动复活。

❌ 事实误判 | 只盯通知时点

✕ B: 把 actual notice 当成能复活已灭的权利。

❌ 法律适用 | 契约保护混用

✕ C: 以为 warranty deed 能替代地役权存在。

❌ 概念混淆 | 公示效力误判

✕ D: 以为 public record 一公开就永远有效。

这题建议用什么方法？

先找终止原因，再看后续转让；权利已灭时，通知和登记都不是救命按钮。

考场速记

记住 DAMPER：Destruction、Abandonment、Merger、Prescription、Estoppel、Release。这题命中的是 Merger：一旦并权，旧地役权就死了，后面再分割也不会自动复活。

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
In a written and signed agreement, a woman, for a fee, granted her neighbor the right to access his property by way of a driveway he was to construct across her property. The neighbor, who could access his property via other reasonable means, had sought the access right because it was more convenient. The neighbor did not record the agreement. Due to financial concerns, the neighbor did not construct the driveway, but he intended to do so in the future.
Six months later, the woman sold her property to a buyer. The buyer did not record her deed from the woman. The buyer had no knowledge of the neighbor's right of access across the property she had purchased.
Yesterday, a year after the sale, the neighbor informed the buyer that he plans to construct the driveway next week.
The jurisdiction has a notice recording act.
If the buyer sues to prevent the neighbor from constructing the driveway, will the buyer be successful?

choices.A: No, because the buyer failed to record her deed from the woman.
choices.B: No, because the neighbor's agreement with the woman created an express easement, which cannot be terminated by mere nonuse.
choices.C: Yes, because the buyer lacked notice of the neighbor's right to construct a driveway on her property.
choices.D: Yes, because the neighbor failed to construct the driveway on the property before the woman sold the property.

questions.explanation:
Types of recording acts
Type Effect Statutory language
Race Interest holder who records first will prevail “First record”
Notice Subsequent BFP without notice of earlier property interest will prevail “Without notice,” “In good faith”
Race-Notice Subsequent BFP (1) without notice of earlier property interest (2) who records first will prevail “Without notice, who shall first record”
BFP = Bona fide purchaser.

An easement is a nonpossessory interest in real property that gives the easement holder the right to use another’s land for a specific, limited purpose – eg, the neighbor’s right to construct a driveway across her property. As real property interests, easements are subject to the jurisdiction’s recording act. Under a notice recording act (as seen here), a real property interest cannot be enforced against a subsequent purchaser of a conflicting real property interest who lacks notice (actual, record, or inquiry) of the prior interest.

Here, the buyer had no knowledge of the neighbor’s easement when she purchased the property (no actual notice). Additionally, the neighbor had neither recorded the agreement in which the woman granted him the easement (no record notice) nor constructed the driveway (no inquiry notice) at that time. Therefore, the neighbor cannot enforce his easement against the buyer, and she can prevent him from constructing a driveway across her property.

(Choice A) A purchaser who is protected by a recording act (eg, the buyer) does not have to record his/her property interest to enjoy the act’s protection from a person who had previously acquired a conflicting interest in the same property (eg, the neighbor).

(Choice B) An easement is terminated by abandonment if the easement holder acts in an affirmative way that shows a clear intent to relinquish the easement right – mere nonuse is insufficient. Therefore, the neighbor’s express easement was not terminated by his mere failure to construct the driveway. But that easement is unenforceable because the buyer is protected by the notice recording act.

(Choice D) The neighbor’s failure to construct a driveway on the property before the woman sold it helps show that the buyer lacked inquiry notice of the neighbor’s easement. But the buyer will only be successful because she also lacked actual and record notice.

📌 Educational Objective

Under a notice recording act, a real property interest (eg, easement) cannot be enforced against a subsequent purchaser of a conflicting real property interest (eg, the land subject to the easement) who lacks notice of the prior interest.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Third) of Property § 7.14 (Am. Law Inst. 2000) (extinguishment of servitude benefits under recording act).
questions.zh-question:
在一份书面签署的协议中，一名女子在收取费用后，授予其邻居一项权利，邻居可以通过其将在女子地产上修建的一条车道进入其自己的地产。该邻居本可以通过其他合理方式进入其地产，但他为了更方便而寻求此通行权。邻居并未登记该协议。由于财务问题，邻居没有修建车道，但他打算将来再修建。

六个月后，该女子将其地产出售给一名买方。买方没有登记她从该女子处获得的契约。买方对邻居在她所购地产上拥有的通行权毫不知情。

昨天，即交易一年后，邻居通知买方，他计划下周修建车道。

该司法管辖区实行通知登记法(notice recording act)。

如果买方提起诉讼，要求阻止邻居修建车道，买方会胜诉吗？

zh-choices.A: 不会，因为买方未能登记她从女子处获得的契约。
zh-choices.B: 不会，因为邻居与女子的协议设立了一项明示地役权(express easement)，该权利不能仅因不使用而被终止。
zh-choices.C: 会，因为买方对邻居有权在其地产上修建车道一事不知情。
zh-choices.D: 会，因为邻居在该女子出售地产前未能修建车道。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Rights in Real Property - Delivery and Recording of Deed

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：在notice recording act（通知登记法）下，后买人没有对先前的easement（地役权）知悉时，能不能把这个地役权挡回去。

三秒认题路径：

地役权 → 未登记 → 后买人无通知 → notice act → 买方赢

核心法律规则

把规则说成人话

先看这是不是 easement（地役权），它也是不动产利益，所以要受登记规则管。notice recording act（通知登记法）的考场意思：后来的买家如果拿到的是冲突的不动产利益，而且对先前利益没有 actual notice（实际通知）、record notice（登记通知）或 inquiry notice（询问通知），就可以把先前利益挡住。
这题里买方买房时根本不知道邻居的地役权，邻居又没登记，也没有已经建成的车道让人起疑，所以邻居这条通行权不能拿来对抗买方。

核心判例： Mohawk Industries v. Carpenter 不适用；本题真正锁定的是通知登记法下“无通知的后买人优先”这一条规则。

思维导图

女人
先前授予地役权的人
→
邻居
拿到未登记地役权
→
买方
后买人且无通知
→
结果
可阻止修车道
关键关卡：买方买房时有没有先前地役权的通知？
没有实际通知：她不知道邻居有权通行。
没有登记通知：邻居没把协议登记进公示系统。
没有询问通知：现场也没有车道等迹象逼她去查。
卡死点：三种通知都没有，邻居的地役权就挡不住买方。
买方是否必须先登记自己的契据？
不需要。她作为受保护的后买人，靠的是“无通知”这一点，不是靠自己先登记。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：买方自己没登记契据，所以她不能赢。

但考试真正问的是：她买的时候有没有先前地役权的通知；这里她没有，所以她能挡住邻居。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

另一个坑是把“邻居后来才说要建车道”当成新权利。不是，决定胜负的是她买房那一刻有没有 notice，不是邻居什么时候宣布要用。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 C？

题干 buyer had no knowledge，而邻居又没登记、现场也没有可疑车道，说明买方在买房时没有任何通知，所以她可以阻止邻居施工。

❌ 事实误判 | 自己登记误判

✕ A: 把 failed to record 当成买方要件了。

❌ 法律适用 | 非终止逻辑

✕ B: 把地役权“没用”误当成已消灭了。

❌ 概念混淆 | 先后顺序混淆

✕ D: 盯着 before the woman sold，却漏掉真正关键是买方是否有通知。

这题建议用什么方法？

先抓登记法类型，再逐个排查三种通知，最后看后买人能不能把先前不动产利益挡回去。

考场速记

记住这句：通知登记法看的是“买的时候知不知道”，不是“后来能不能补救”。遇到地役权、契据或其他不动产利益冲突，先问实际通知、登记通知、询问通知有没有缺口，再决定谁赢。

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
A woman owned a house on a lot abutting a public street. Six months ago, the city validly revised its zoning ordinances and placed the woman's lot and the surrounding lots abutting the public street from the north in a zone limited to residential use; the lots abutting the public street on the south side were zoned for both residential and light business use.
The woman asked the city's zoning appeals board to approve her proposal to operate a court-reporting service from her house. This type of use would be permitted on the south side of the public street and, in fact, one such business has existed there for several years.
The board approved the woman's proposal. Why?

choices.A: A variance was granted.
choices.B: The doctrine of amortization applied.
choices.C: The doctrine of change of circumstances applied.
choices.D: The woman's use of her house was a nonconforming use.

questions.explanation:
Analysis for granting variance
Does use of land or look of structure comply with zoning?
Yes → No variance required
No ↓
Will compliance cause landowner unnecessary hardship?
  • Landowner cannot use property without variance
  • Hardship not self-imposed
No → Deny variance
Yes ↓
Is use contrary to public interest?
  • Compromises public health, safety & general welfare
  • Deviates from comprehensive plan
Yes → Deny variance
No ↓ Grant variance

A variance is created when a local government (often a zoning board) gives a landowner permission to deviate from a zoning requirement. There are two types of variances:

  • use variances — allow land to be used differently than the currently zoned use (eg, commercial use in residential area) and
  • area variances — allow structures on the land to look different than structures on the rest of the zoned area (eg, height, lot size, building placement).

Variances are often granted if the landowner can show that (1) enforcement of a zoning requirement would cause the landowner unnecessary hardship † regarding the use of the land and (2) the variance would not be contrary to public interest (eg, public safety, comprehensive planning).

Here, the revised ordinance placed the woman's house in a zone limited to residential use. The enforcement of this ordinance would cause hardship to the woman's use of the land by preventing the operation of a court-reporting service from her house. This hardship would be unnecessary, and a variance would have little impact on public interest, because light business use is permitted across the street. As a result, the board likely approved the woman's proposal by granting a variance.

† Courts often reject landowners' claims of unnecessary hardship when the hardship is self-imposed or the landowner can still make use of the property without a variance.

(Choices B & D) The doctrine of amortization applies to a nonconforming use — ie, one that lawfully existed before but is now prohibited by a zoning law. Since the woman's court-reporting service does not yet exist, this doctrine does not apply. But even if it did, it would allow the government to terminate (not approve) a nonconforming use after a reasonable time that allows a landowner to gradually phase out or recoup an investment in that use.

(Choice C) The doctrine of changed circumstances (ie, changed conditions) terminates or prevents the enforcement of a real covenant or equitable servitude that no longer provides its intended benefit — but it does not apply to zoning ordinances.

📌 Educational Objective

Variances are often granted if (1) enforcement of a zoning requirement would cause the landowner unnecessary hardship regarding the use of the land and (2) a variance would not be contrary to a public interest.

📚 References
  • 83 Am. Jur. 2d Zoning & Planning §§ 706–93 (2019) (providing an overview on variances).
  • E & F Assocs., LLC v. Zoning Bd. of Appeals, 127 A.3d 986, 990 (Conn. 2015) (defining variance and identifying considerations in granting a variance).

一名女子拥有一所房子，其地块毗邻一条公共街道。六个月前，该市有效地修订了其区划条例，将该女子地块及北侧毗邻公共街道的周边地块划入仅限住宅用途的区域；而南侧毗邻公共街道的地块则被划为住宅和轻型商业两用区。

该女子请求市区的区划上诉委员会批准她在家中经营庭审记录服务的提议。这种用途在公共街道的南侧是被允许的，事实上，那里已经有一家此类企业经营了数年。

委员会批准了该女子的提议。为什么？

zh-choices.A: 授予了一项用途特许(variance)。
zh-choices.B: 适用了摊销原则。
zh-choices.C: 适用了情势变更原则。
zh-choices.D: 该女子对其房屋的使用属于不合规定用途。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Rights in Real Property - Zoning & land use

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：既有住宅想改成受限区里的商业用途时，能不能靠 变更（variance） 拿到例外许可。

三秒认题路径：

分区改了 → 现用途不合规 → 看 hardship → 再看公众利益 → 选 variance

核心法律规则

只抓这条就够做题

变更（variance） 是地方 zoning board 允许土地偏离分区要求的许可，考场意思：你本来不准这么用，但 board 可以特批你继续。若强制遵守会让土地所有人遭遇 不必要的困难（unnecessary hardship），而且不违反公共利益，就可能批。这里题干说北侧住宅区内不能做该类业务，但南侧街对面本来就允许轻商业，说明这次申请更像是拿 variance 过关，而不是在谈旧有用途的续命。

核心判例： E & F Assocs., LLC v. Zoning Bd. of Appeals — 说明 variance 的核心就是 hardship 加上不违背公共利益。

思维导图

先问：这是不是已经存在、现在被禁掉的用途？
不是 本题不是 nonconforming use
题干里这家 court-reporting service 还没开，不能套“既有合法用途被新法赶走”的那条路。
再问：不给例外会不会让土地根本没法合理使用？
会
北侧已改成纯住宅，若硬卡住商业办公用途，房主就会遇到 unnecessary hardship。
最后问：这个例外会不会伤到公共利益？
不会
对街南侧本来就允许轻商业，说明这次放行不会明显破坏整体分区规划。
结论
满足 hardship + 不违背公共利益 → 批准 variance → 选 A

考点陷阱

你可能会想：对街已经有轻商业，而且她也想开业务，所以是不是 nonconforming use 或者 amortization 之类的老规则。

但考试真正问的是：这块地现在能不能因 unnecessary hardship 拿到分区例外，不是在问旧业务怎么被“慢慢淘汰”。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。 本题同理，考的是能否批例外，不是街对面到底有没有别的生意。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 A？

题干的关键事实是：住宅区改限后，她的 court-reporting service 在自家房里被卡住，但对街已有轻商业，足以支持 variance 的 hardship 和公共利益判断。

❌ 法律适用 | 扩张误判

✕ B: 把 amortization 当成批准工具了。

❌ 概念混淆 | 规则渊源误判

✕ C: 误把 changed circumstances 当成分区规则。

❌ 事实误判 | 既有用途偷换

✕ D: 她的业务还没开始，不能说成 nonconforming use。

这题建议用什么方法？

先看是不是既有用途，再看 hardship 和公共利益，别被“对街也能做生意”带偏。

考场速记

记住这句：variance = hardship 过关 + 不伤公共利益；nonconforming use = 旧用途被新规压住，不是拿来批准新业务。

看到“原本不准，但申请人说不批就没法合理用地”，先想 variance；看到“本来合法，现在被新规赶走”，才想 nonconforming use。

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
A man owned in fee simple a lot in a properly approved subdivision, designed and zoned for industrial use. His friend owned the adjoining lot in the same subdivision. The plat of the subdivision was recorded as authorized by statute.
Twelve years ago, the man erected an industrial building wholly situated on his lot but with one wall along the boundary common with the friend's lot. The construction was done as authorized by a building permit that was validly obtained under applicable statutes, ordinances, and regulations. Further, the construction was regularly inspected and found in compliance with all building code requirements.
The friend's lot remained vacant until six months ago, when she began excavation pursuant to a building permit authorizing the erection of an industrial building situated on her lot but with one wall along the boundary common with the man's lot. The excavation caused subsidence of a portion of the man's lot that resulted in injury to his building. The excavation was not done negligently or with any malicious intent to injure.
In the jurisdiction, the time to acquire title by adverse possession or rights by prescription is 10 years.
The man has brought an appropriate action against the friend to recover damages resulting from the injuries to the building on his lot.
Who is likely to prevail?

choices.A: The friend, because both lots are urban land, as distinguished from rural land, so the man had the duty to protect any improvements on his lot.
choices.B: The friend, because the construction and use of her building were authorized by the applicable law.
choices.C: The man, because a right for support, appurtenant to his lot, had been acquired by adverse possession or prescription.
choices.D: The man, if the subsidence would have occurred without the weight of the building on his lot.

questions.explanation:
Withdrawal of lateral & subjacent support

Natural state Improved
Lateral
  • Strictly liable for damage to adjacent land caused by subsidence
  • If damage to land & improvements would have occurred in land's natural state, strictly liable
  • If not, liable if negligent
Subjacent

Landowners have a right to lateral support侧向支撑权：相邻土地所有者依法享有的、要求邻地提供横向土体支撑的权利。 from all adjoining land. Therefore, an adjoining landowner who withdraws lateral support for land in a natural state is strictly liable for any subsidence (ie, cave-in, slippage) that occurs because of that withdrawal. But if the adjoining landowner withdraws lateral support for improved land—as seen with the man's industrial building—the adjoining landowner may be:

  • strictly liable if the landowner can show that damage to the land and improvements would have occurred in the land's natural state or
  • liable for negligence if the landowner cannot make such a showing.

Here, the friend's excavation was not done negligently or with any malicious intent to injure the man. This means that the man can only recover damages resulting from the injuries to his improved land if the friend is subject to strict liability.

And if the man shows that the subsidence would have occurred without the weight of the building on his lot, he will likely prevail.

(Choice A) A possessor of land in an urban area has a duty to exercise reasonable care to prevent an unreasonable risk of harm arising from conditions on his/her land. Here, there is no evidence that the man (or the friend) breached this duty, so this principle would not affect the outcome of the lawsuit.

(Choice B) The fact that the construction and use of the friend's building were authorized by law helps show that the friend was not negligent, but it does not shield her from strict liability since it is imposed regardless of fault.

(Choice C) A landowner cannot acquire a right to lateral support by adverse possession or prescription侵权逆占或时效取得：不能通过对相邻土地的实际占有或持续使用而获得侧向支撑权。. That is because there is no actual possession or use of the adjoining land to satisfy the elements of those claims.

📌 Educational Objective

An adjoining landowner who withdraws lateral support for improved land is (1) strictly liable if the landowner can show that damage to the land and improvements would have occurred in the land's natural state or (2) liable for negligence if no such showing is made.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Second) of Torts §§ 817–18 (Am. Law Inst. 1979) (withdrawal of lateral support).
questions.zh-question:
一名男子以完全所有权（fee simple）拥有一块位于经合法批准的、为工业用途设计和规划的细分地块。他的朋友拥有同一细分地块中的相邻地块。该细分地块的规划图已根据法规授权进行了登记。

十二年前，该男子在他的地块上建造了一座工业建筑，建筑完全位于其地块内，但有一堵墙紧邻与朋友地块的共同边界。该建筑的施工获得了根据适用法规、条例和规章有效取得的建筑许可的授权。此外，该建筑经过定期检查，被认定符合所有建筑规范要求。

朋友的地块一直空置，直到六个月前，她根据一份建筑许可开始挖掘。该许可授权其在地块上建造一座工业建筑，同样有一堵墙紧邻与男子地块的共同边界。该挖掘导致男子地块的一部分下沉，从而对其建筑造成了损害。该挖掘并非出于过失或任何恶意伤害的意图。

在该司法管辖区，通过侵权逆占（adverse possession）或时效取得（prescription）获得所有权或权利的时效为10年。

该男子已对朋友提起适当的诉讼，要求赔偿其地块上建筑所受的损害。

谁可能胜诉？

zh-choices.A: 朋友，因为两块地块均为城市土地，而非乡村土地，因此男子有责任保护其地块上的任何改良物。
zh-choices.B: 朋友，因为她的建筑的施工和使用得到了适用法律的授权。
zh-choices.C: 男子，因为其地块的附属支撑权已通过侵权逆占（adverse possession）或时效取得（prescription）获得。
zh-choices.D: 男子，如果即使没有其地块上建筑的重量，地面下沉仍然会发生。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Rights in Real Property - Other Property Rights--Water, Air, Support

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：相邻土地挖掘导致侧向支撑（lateral support）被抽走后，邻地对 改良土地（improved land） 何时要负 严格责任（strict liability）。

三秒认题路径：

相邻挖掘 → 地基下沉 → 改良土地 → 自然状态也会塌？ → 选 D

核心法律规则

土地所有人对相邻土地享有侧向支撑（lateral support）；邻地一旦把这份支撑拿走，若受损的是自然状态（natural state）的土地，通常直接看 strict liability。如果受损的是有建筑等改良（improvements）的土地，先问：就算没有这些建筑，地面本身会不会一样下沉。

会一样下沉，就按严格责任；不会一样下沉，而是因为建筑重量才塌，那通常只在对方过失（negligence）时才赔。题目已说好友挖掘并不疏忽、也无恶意，所以本题就卡在“自然状态下也会不会塌”这一问。

核心判例： Restatement (Second) of Torts §§ 817–18 的思路就是：改良土地受损时，先看自然状态会不会同样下沉；会，就能走严格责任。

思维导图

题干先看什么？邻地挖掘有没有拿走 侧向支撑（lateral support）
YES 有下沉，继续问受损对象是什么。
受损的是自然状态土地，还是带建筑的改良土地？
自然状态 → 直接严格责任，塌了就赔
改良土地 → 先看“没建筑也会塌吗”
会 → 还是严格责任，建筑不是挡箭牌
不会 → 只有证明 过失（negligence） 才赔
NO 如果题干没说下沉或没说抽走支撑，就别乱套本题规则。
本题已给：并非过失/无恶意，所以关键只剩“自然状态也会不会塌”
结论：若会塌，答案就是 D

考点陷阱

你可能会想：对方有合法建筑许可、又不是故意挖坏，所以她应该没责任。

但考试真正问的是：她有没有抽走邻地应有的侧向支撑（lateral support），以及这块地在自然状态（natural state）下会不会也一样下沉。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 D？

题干关键事实是：挖掘导致地基下沉并伤到建筑，且只要证明即使没有这栋楼也会塌，友人就要负严格责任。

❌ 事实误判 | 城市土地误读

✕ A: 把“urban”当成自动加重男方义务，忽略了本题真正的支点是侧向支撑。

❌ 法律适用 | 许可抗辩误判

✕ B: 看到 authorized by law 就以为免赔，但严格责任不看她有没有合法施工。

❌ 概念混淆 | 时效取得误判

✕ C: 想把侧向支撑当成能靠 prescription 取得的权利，其实不能这样取得。

这题建议用什么方法？

先锁定“抽走支撑”再做自然状态测试；题干若已排除过失，就直接看严格责任。

考场速记

口诀：“先看自然状态，再看改良重量；会塌就严责，不会塌才找过失。”

记住：侧向支撑题的核心不是“有没有许可”，而是“没这栋楼，地还会不会照样塌”。

D.text: without the weight of the building

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
A tenant leased a commercial property from a landlord for a 12-year term. The property included a large store and a parking lot. At the start of the lease period, the tenant took possession and with the landlord's oral consent installed counters, display cases, removable shelving, and special lighting. Both parties complied with all lease terms.
The lease is set to expire next month. Two weeks ago, when the landlord contacted the tenant about a possible lease renewal, she learned that the tenant had decided not to renew the lease and planned to remove all of the above-listed items on or before the lease termination date. The landlord claimed that all the items had become part of the real estate and had to remain on the premises. The tenant asserted his right and intention to remove all the items.
Both the lease and the statutes of the jurisdiction are silent on the matter in dispute. At the time the landlord consented and the tenant installed the items, nothing was said about the tenant's right to retain or remove the items.
The landlord has sued the tenant to enjoin his removal of the items. How is the court likely to rule?

choices.A: For the landlord as to items bolted or otherwise attached to the premises, and for the tenant as to items not attached to the premises other than by weight.
choices.B: For the landlord, because the items have become part of the landlord's real estate.
choices.C: For the tenant, because all of the items may be removed as trade fixtures without any obligation to restore the premises.
choices.D: For the tenant, provided that the tenant reasonably restores the premises to the prior condition or pays for the cost of restoration.

questions.explanation:
When tenant can remove item without landlord's consent

Personal property
Movable or intangible thing that is subject to ownership and not real property
Trade fixture
Removable personal property tenant attaches to land for trade/business use
Fixture
Personal property so attached that it is considered part of real property
Real property
Land and anything permanently attached to the land
Tenant can remove
Tenant cannot remove

Absent an agreement to the contrary, a tenant can remove a fixture—i.e., an item so connected with real property that it is considered part of the real property—that the tenant has attached to leased property if:

  • the leased property can be and is restored to its former condition after the removal and
  • the removal and restoration are made within a reasonable time.

This rule applies to both residential and commercial tenants. A trade fixture is personal property that a tenant attaches to leased premises for use in the tenant's trade or business.

Here, the counters, display cases, removable shelving, and special lighting are trade fixtures since the tenant installed them for use in the store that he leased from the landlord. The tenant can remove these items if he reasonably restores the premises to its prior condition within a reasonable time or pays for the cost of restoration.

(Choice A) Although some of the tenant's trade fixtures may be bolted or otherwise attached to the premises, there is no evidence that removing them will substantially harm the property such that it cannot be restored. Therefore, the court will likely allow the tenant to remove all of these items regardless of how they were attached.

(Choice B) Generally fixtures are considered part of the real property. But the tenant retains ownership of the fixtures and can remove them from the landlord's property if the above conditions are met.

(Choice C) The tenant is obligated to reasonably restore the premises to its prior condition within a reasonable time if the fixtures are removed.

📌 Educational Objective

Trade fixtures can be removed without the landlord's consent if the (1) leased property can be and is restored and (2) restoration occurs within a reasonable time.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Second) of Property: Landlord & Tenant §§ 12.2–12.3 (Am. L. Inst. 1997) (explaining restoration after removal of trade fixtures).
questions.zh-question:
一名租户向房东租赁了一处商业地产，租期为12年。该地产包括一个大商铺和一个停车场。租赁期开始时，租户占有该地产，并在房东的口头同意下，安装了柜台、陈列柜、可移动货架和特殊照明设备。双方均遵守了所有租赁条款。

租赁合同将于下月到期。两周前，当房东联系租户商讨续租可能性时，她得知租户已决定不续租，并计划在租赁终止日或之前拆除所有上述物品。房东主张，所有这些物品已成为房地产的一部分，必须保留在该物业中。租户则声称其有权并意图拆除所有物品。

租赁合同和该司法管辖区的法规对争议事项均未作规定。在房东同意且租户安装这些物品时，双方并未就租户保留或拆除这些物品的权利进行任何约定。

房东已起诉租户，请求法院发布禁令，禁止其拆除这些物品。法院可能会如何裁决？

zh-choices.A: 支持房东，针对以螺栓固定或以其他方式附着于物业的物品；支持租户，针对除因自身重量外未附着于物业的物品。
zh-choices.B: 支持房东，因为这些物品已成为房东房地产的一部分。
zh-choices.C: 支持租户，因为所有物品都可以作为营业附加物被拆除，且没有义务恢复物业原状。
zh-choices.D: 支持租户，前提是租户将物业合理地恢复到先前的状态，或支付恢复费用。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Rights in Real Property - Fixtures

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：商业租客安装的 商业性附属物（trade fixtures） 能不能在租期结束前自行拆走，关键看能否在合理时间内恢复原状。

三秒认题路径：

商业租赁 → 租客安装 → trade fixtures → 可恢复原状 → 可拆走

核心法律规则

一般规则是：租客附着到租赁房屋上的 附属物（fixture），如果本质上还是为经营用途安装的 商业性附属物（trade fixture），租期内或到期时通常可以拆走。考试真正盯的是两个点：拆除后房屋能不能被 恢复原状（restore to former condition），以及恢复动作是不是在 合理时间（reasonable time） 内完成。只要这两点过关，房东通常不能因为“它看起来像房屋的一部分”就把它永远留在地里。

核心判例： Restatement (Second) of Property: Landlord & Tenant §§ 12.2–12.3 - 商业性附属物可拆，但要能合理恢复原状。

思维导图

商业租客
安装 counters / shelving / lighting
→
商业性附属物
为经营而装，不是永久并入土地
→
能否拆走？
看恢复原状与时间
→
答案：租客可拆
但要合理恢复或承担修复费
先问：这是不是租客为经营装的 trade fixture？
是：继续问能不能拆。
拆完后，房屋能否恢复到原状，且在合理时间内完成？
YES：租客可以拆走，选 D。
NO：不能无偿拆走，房东可拦。
不是：更像并入不动产的一般 fixture，租客就危险了。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：既然这些东西已经钉在地上、接上电线，看起来就是房屋的一部分，那就应该都归房东。

但考试真正问的是：它们是不是为租客的生意装上的 商业性附属物（trade fixtures），以及拆完后能不能在合理时间内恢复原状。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 D？

题干明确是商业租客安装的 counters / shelving / lighting，属于 trade fixtures；只要能在合理时间内恢复原状或承担恢复费用，就能拆走。

❌ 事实误判 | 过度看固定方式

✕ A: 把“钉没钉住”看得太重了，忽略了这是为经营装的 trade fixtures。

❌ 概念混淆 | 直接并入土地

✕ B: 看到像 real estate 就全收走，漏掉了租客对商业性附属物的保留权。

❌ 法律适用 | 少了恢复条件

✕ C: 以为“能拆”就等于“随便拆”，但题目还要求恢复原状。

这题建议用什么方法？

先认定是商业性附属物，再检查恢复原状与合理时间，最后判断能不能拆。

考场速记

记忆口诀：trade fixture 能拆，但要 restore + reasonable time。看到租客为生意装的东西，先别急着归房东，先问“拆完能不能修回去”。

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
A couple owned a tract of land called Lot 1. An old road ran through Lot 1 from the abutting public highway, which the couple used to haul wood from Lot 1. Without the couple's permission and with no initial right, their neighbor—the owner of Lot 2, which adjoined Lot 1—traveled over the old road for a period of 15 years to obtain access to Lot 2, although Lot 2 abutted another public road. Occasionally, the neighbor made repairs to the old road.
The period of time to acquire rights by prescription in the jurisdiction is 10 years.
After the expiration of 15 years, the couple conveyed a portion of Lot 1 to a friend. The deed included the following clause: "together with the right to pass and repass at all times and for all purposes over the old road." The friend built a house fronting on the old road.
The road was severely damaged by a spring flood, and the friend made substantial repairs to the road. The friend asked the neighbor and the couple to contribute one-third each to the cost of repairing the flood damage. They both refused, and the friend brought an appropriate action to compel contribution from the couple and the neighbor.
What is the likely outcome of this action?

choices.A: The friend will lose as to both defendants.
choices.B: The friend will win as to both defendants.
choices.C: The friend will win as to the couple, but lose as to the neighbor.
choices.D: The friend will win as to the neighbor, but lose as to the couple.

questions.explanation:
Repairing & maintaining easement

Duty to repair & maintain Duty to contribute
Easement holder must repair & maintain easement to extent necessary to:
  • prevent unreasonable interference with enjoyment of servient estate
  • protect servient-estate owner from liability to third parties
 Other easement holders and/or servient-estate owner who share easement must contribute to reasonable costs of repairs & maintenance

The duty to repair and maintain an easement falls on the easement holder† — not the servient-estate owner需役地所有人：其土地供他人地役权使用的土地所有者。 (unless the parties agree otherwise). However, the servient-estate owner需役地所有人：其土地供他人地役权使用的土地所有者。 has a duty to contribute to the reasonable costs of repairs and maintenance if he/she also uses the easement. The same applies to other easement holders who share the use of the easement.

Here, the couple (servient-estate owner需役地所有人：其土地供他人地役权使用的土地所有者。) conveyed an easement to the friend that allowed the friend to use the old road on their land. But the couple also used the road to haul wood. And the neighbor obtained a prescriptive easement时效地役权：通过公开、持续、敌对地使用他人土地达法定年限而取得的地役权。 to use the road by openly and continuously using the road for 15 years without the couple's permission. As a result, the couple and the neighbor were obligated to contribute to the costs incurred by the friend in repairing the road. Therefore, the friend will likely win against both in his action to compel contribution (Choices A, C & D).

†This obligation also extends to repair and maintenance of portions of the servient estate and improvements used to enjoy the easement, so long as they are within the easement holder's control.

📌 Educational Objective

An easement holder has a duty to repair and maintain the easement. If the easement is shared by other easement holders or the servient-estate owner, those parties are obligated to contribute to the reasonable costs of repairs and maintenance.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Third) of Property: Servitudes § 4.13 (Am. Law Inst. 2000) (duty to repair and maintain easement).
questions.zh-question:
一对夫妇拥有一块名为 Lot 1 的土地。一条旧路从与 Lot 1 相邻的公共高速公路穿过，该夫妇曾用此路从 Lot 1 运送木材。在未经该夫妇许可且无初始权利的情况下，他们的邻居——与 Lot 1 相邻的 Lot 2 的所有者——为了进入 Lot 2 而使用这条旧路长达15年，尽管 Lot 2 本身也邻接另一条公共道路。邻居偶尔会对这条旧路进行维修。

在该司法管辖区，通过时效取得权利的期限为10年。

15年期满后，该夫妇将 Lot 1 的一部分转让给了一位朋友。地契中包含以下条款：“（受让人）享有在任何时候为任何目的通行于该旧路的权利。”这位朋友建了一座房子，正面对着这条旧路。

这条路因春季洪水而严重受损，朋友对道路进行了大量维修。朋友要求邻居和该夫妇各分摊三分之一的洪水损害维修费用。他们都拒绝了，于是朋友提起了适当的诉讼，要求该夫妇和邻居承担分摊费用。

此诉讼可能的结果是什么？

zh-choices.A: 朋友将对两名被告均败诉。
zh-choices.B: 朋友将对两名被告均胜诉。
zh-choices.C: 朋友将对该夫妇胜诉，但对邻居败诉。
zh-choices.D: 朋友将对邻居胜诉，但对该夫妇败诉。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Rights in Real Property - Easements

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：地役权（easement）的维修义务在谁身上，以及共享使用者要不要按比例分摊修理费。

三秒认题路径：

地役权修理 → 谁在用路 → 共享使用 → 要分摊 → 选双方都要付

核心法律规则

一般规则是：地役权持有人（easement holder）负责维修和维护，考场意思：不是先看土地原主人，而是先看谁拿着通行权在用这条路。

如果需役地所有人（servient-estate owner）或其他地役权持有人（easement holders）也共同使用这条地役权，他们就要按合理比例分担修理与维护费用。

所以这题的关键不是“谁造成洪水”，而是“谁在共享使用旧路”。

核心判例：本题适用《Restatement (Third) of Property: Servitudes § 4.13》的思路：负责修理的是使用地役权的人，共用的人要分摊。

思维导图

友人 明文受让地役权
→
旧路地役权 需要维修
←
夫妻 需役地所有人，也在用路
←
邻居 时效地役权，持续用路15年
先看谁该修：地役权持有人 = 友人
再看谁要分摊：夫妻也用路；邻居有 时效地役权（prescriptive easement），也在共享使用。
卡死结论：共享使用者都要按合理费用出钱
答案：友人对夫妻和邻居都能要求分摊。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：夫妻是土地原主，修路当然该他们全包；邻居只是“偶尔修过路”，不算真正使用者。

但考试真正问的是：谁在共享这条 easement，谁就要分摊合理修理费，不是看谁当初有没有把路“弄坏”。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 B？

题干里夫妻和邻居都在共享使用旧路，所以友人修路后可向二者都追偿合理分摊。

❌ 事实误判 | 漏掉共用

✕ A: 把夫妻看成完全没用路，忽略了他们一直在通行。

❌ 法律适用 | 只看受让人

✕ C: 只盯着夫妻是原始土地所有人，却忘了他们也在用 old road。

❌ 概念混淆 | 把时效权当排他

✕ D: 以为邻居拿到时效地役权后就不用分摊，错在把“有权使用”当成“可白用”。

这题建议用什么方法？

先锁定谁是地役权持有人，再逐个问：谁也在用这条路，谁就要分摊修理费。

考场速记

记住一句：谁用地役权，谁分修理费；共同使用，按合理比例分摊。

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
A man's home was mortgaged to a bank by a duly recorded purchase-money mortgage. Last year, the man replaced all of the home's old windows with new windows.
Each new window consists of a window frame with three inserts: regular windows, storm windows, and screens. The windows are designed so that each insert can be easily inserted or removed from the window frame without tools to adjust to seasonal change and to facilitate the cleaning of the inserts.
The new windows were expensive. The man purchased them on credit, signed a financing statement, and granted a security interest in the windows to the supplier of the windows. The supplier promptly and properly filed and recorded the financing statement before the windows were installed. The man stored the old windows in the basement of the home.
This year, the man has suffered severe financial reverses and has defaulted on his mortgage obligation to the bank and on his obligation to the supplier.
The bank brought an appropriate action to enjoin the supplier from its proposed repossession of the window inserts.
In the action, for whom should the court rule?

choices.A: The bank, because its mortgage was recorded first.
choices.B: The bank, because windows and screens, no matter their characteristics, are an integral part of a house.
choices.C: The supplier, because the availability of the old windows enables the bank to return the home to its original condition.
choices.D: The supplier, because the inserts are removable.

questions.explanation:
Fixture v. Chattel

Is object attached to the land?
No
Yes
Is object intended to remain attached to the land?
No
Yes
Is object being used for a larger component or function of the land?
No
Yes
Object is a fixture
Object is a chattel (ie, personal property)

A mortgage is a lien against real property that is used to secure repayment of a debt. This gives the recipient of the mortgage (ie, the mortgagee) a legal interest in the mortgaged property and any fixtures later added to that property. A fixture is an object (ie, personal property) that is:

  • attached to real property with the intent that it remain attached and
  • used for some larger component (eg, lighting, water drainage) or function (eg, plumbing, septic) of the real property.

In other words, a fixture is an object that is so attached to real property that it is essentially a part of that property.

Here, the new window inserts were integral as a larger component of the man's house. But they are not fixtures because they are easily removable and therefore not attached to the house. As a result, the window inserts are not part of the bank's purchase-money mortgage. This means that the bank has no standing to enjoin (ie, stop) the supplier from repossessing them (Choice B).

(Choice A) A first recorded lien generally has priority优先权：当多个担保权益针对同一财产时，先登记或先成立的权益通常优先受偿。 over subsequent liens on the same property, and a purchase-money mortgage (recorded or not) generally has priority over all other liens on the property. But here, priority is irrelevant since the bank and the supplier have mortgages over different property — the home and new windows, respectively.

(Choice C) Since the window inserts are easily removable, they would not be fixtures even if the old windows were unavailable and the bank could not return the home to its original condition.

📌 Educational Objective

A mortgage includes the property and any fixtures added to that property before or after the mortgage was created. A fixture is an item that is (1) attached to property with the intent that it remain attached and (2) used for a larger component or function of the property.

📚 References
  • 35A Am. Jur. 2d Fixtures § 1 (2019) (defining fixture).
questions.zh-question:
一名男子的房屋通过正式记录的购房抵押贷款向银行办理了抵押。去年，该男子将房屋的所有旧窗户更换为新窗户。

每扇新窗户由一个窗框和三个可插入部分组成：普通窗、防风窗和纱窗。这些窗户的设计使得每个可插入部分无需工具即可轻松地从窗框中装入或取出，以适应季节变化并方便清洁。

这些新窗户价格昂贵。该男子通过信贷购买，签署了一份融资声明，并将窗户的担保权益授予了窗户的供应商。在窗户安装之前，供应商及时并适当地提交并记录了该融资声明。该男子将旧窗户存放在房屋的地下室中。

今年，该男子遭遇了严重的财务困境，拖欠了对银行的抵押贷款债务以及对供应商的债务。

银行提起了适当的诉讼，请求禁止供应商收回其提议要收回的窗户可插入部分。

在该诉讼中，法院应裁定哪一方胜诉？

zh-choices.A: 银行，因为其抵押贷款先被记录。
zh-choices.B: 银行，因为无论其特性如何，窗户和纱窗都是房屋不可分割的一部分。
zh-choices.C: 供应商，因为旧窗户的存在使得银行能够将房屋恢复到其原始状态。
zh-choices.D: 供应商，因为这些可插入部分是可拆卸的。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Rights in Real Property - Fixtures

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：新装的窗户配件到底是附着物（fixture）还是动产（chattel），所以银行的抵押权能不能管到它。

三秒认题路径：

先看是否附着 → 再看是否想留住 → 再看是否成整体 → 不是就不算 fixture

核心法律规则

只抓决定胜负的规则

抵押（mortgage）担保的是土地本身，以及之后加到土地上的附着物（fixtures）。判断 fixture 的关键不是“贵不贵”或“好不好用”，而是两步：一，是否真正附着到不动产；二，是否打算一直留在那里，并且成为房屋更大组成部分或功能的一部分。

如果物件只是能轻松拆下、随时带走，它就是chattel，也就是个人财产，银行的房屋抵押权就碰不到它。这个题里，窗户插片虽然有用，但能无工具轻易拆装，所以考试上直接往“不是 fixture”走。

核心判例：本题规则与 35A Am. Jur. 2d Fixtures § 1 的定义一致：重点看附着性和是否成为房屋一部分，而不是外观上像不像房子配件。

思维导图

窗户插片要不要算 fixture？
先问 1：有没有真正附着到房屋？
本题：能无工具插入、拆出，几乎不固定在房屋上
直接卡掉：附着性太弱 → 更像 chattel
再问 2：是不是打算长期留在房屋里，变成房屋一部分？
本题：只是为季节调节和清洁方便而拆装，不是“固定留下”
第三要件也不稳：不能把它硬说成 fixture
结论：不是 fixture → 不进银行房屋抵押范围 → 供应商可追索
答案：选 D

考点陷阱

你可能会想：窗户和窗户插片都装在房子上，而且还是房子的重要部分，银行先登记了，当然银行赢。

但考试真正问的是：这些插片到底是不是 fixture，不是在比谁先登记、也不是在比谁更像“房屋的一部分”。司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 D？

题干的 window inserts can be easily inserted or removed without tools，说明它们更像可拆卸动产，不是 fixture，所以银行的抵押权管不到它们。

❌ 法律适用 | 先登误搬

✕ A: 把 recorded first 当成万能规则了。

❌ 概念混淆 | 整体误判

✕ B: 看到窗户就认定都算房屋固定部分，忽略了可拆卸性。

❌ 事实误判 | 原窗偷换

✕ C: 拿 old windows 反推产权，题干真正争的是新插片。

这题建议用什么方法？

先定物件性质，再谈担保范围；只要“不易附着 + 可随手拆下”，就先别把它硬塞进 fixture。

考场速记

记住一句：能不能轻易拆下，往往比“看起来像不像房子的一部分”更重要。 判断 fixture 时先抓“附着 + 留置 + 整体功能”，别被“房子里原本有旧窗户”这种背景带跑。

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
A large tract of land is owned by a religious order. The order erected a large residential building on the land where its members reside. The order's land is surrounded by rural residential properties and its only access to a public way is afforded by an easement over a strip of land 30 feet wide. The easement was granted to the order by deed from a woman who owned one of the adjacent residential properties. The order built a driveway on the strip, and the easement was used for 20 years without incident or objection.
Last year, as permitted by the applicable zoning ordinance, the order constructed a 200-bed nursing home and a parking lot on its land, using all of the land that was available for such development. The nursing home was very successful, and on Sundays visitors to the nursing home overflowed the parking facilities on the land and parked all along the driveway from early in the morning through the evening hours. After two Sundays of the resulting congestion and inconvenience, the woman erected a barrier across the driveway on Sundays preventing any use of the driveway by anyone seeking access to the order's land. The order objected.
The woman brought an appropriate action to terminate the easement.
In this action, for whom will the court likely hold?

choices.A: The order, because expanded use of the easement does not terminate the easement.
choices.B: The order, because the woman's use of self-help denies her the right to equitable relief.
choices.C: The woman, because the order excessively expanded the use of the dominant tenement.
choices.D: The woman, because the parking on the driveway exceeded the scope of the easement.

questions.explanation:
Permissible use of easement
Type Easement holder's use Servient owner's use
Express easement
  • Uses intended by parties OR reasonably necessary to use/enjoy easement if intent is unknown
  • Expansion of use permitted
 Use consistent with easement's terms AND does not unreasonably interfere with its use/enjoyment
Easement by prior use
  • Limited to scope of prior use
  • No expansion of use
Easement by necessity
  • Normal uses needed for dominant estate (eg, ingress/egress, utility lines)
  • Expansion of use permitted
Prescriptive easement
  • Limited to scope of adverse use during prescriptive period
  • No expansion of use

An easement is generally a nonpossessory right to use another's land (ie, servient estate) for a specific purpose. Unless limited by the express terms of the easement, the easement holder has the right to use the servient estate in any manner that is reasonably necessary to use and enjoy the easement—eg, building a driveway on the easement and using the driveway for parking (Choice D).

An easement also anticipates reasonable and natural development of the easement holder's land (ie, dominant estate). Therefore, the easement holder may increase the manner, frequency, and intensity of the easement's use—so long as that increase does not unreasonably damage or interfere with the use or enjoyment of the servient estate.

Here, the order reasonably developed its land as permitted by the zoning ordinance by constructing a 200-bed nursing home and parking lot on it. This caused an increase in the intensity and frequency of the easement's use. But that use was not excessive because there is no evidence that it unreasonably damaged or interfered with the woman's servient estate (Choice C). Even if it did, available remedies可用救济措施：包括自力救济消除妨害、损害赔偿或禁令，而非终止或丧失地役权。 would include self-help abatement (eg, blocking off the easement), damages, or an injunction—not termination or forfeiture of the easement (Choice B).

📌 Educational Objective

An easement holder may increase the manner, frequency, or intensity of an easement's use so long as that increase does not unreasonably damage or interfere with the use or enjoyment of the servient estate.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Third) of Property: Servitudes § 4.10 (Am. Law Inst. 2000) (easement holder's right to use easement).
  • Restatement (Third) of Property: Servitudes § 4.9 (Am. Law Inst. 2000) (servient owner's right to use servient estate).

questions.zh-question:
一个宗教团体拥有一大片土地。该团体在土地上建造了一栋大型住宅楼，供其成员居住。该团体的土地被乡村住宅物业所环绕，其通往公共道路的唯一通道是通过一条30英尺宽地带上的地役权（easement）。该地役权是由一位拥有相邻住宅物业之一的女士通过契据授予该团体的。该团体在该地带上修建了一条车道，该地役权在20年间的使用中未发生任何事故或异议。

去年，根据适用的区划法规的许可，该团体在其土地上建造了一家拥有200个床位的疗养院和一个停车场，用尽了所有可用于此类开发的土地。疗养院非常成功，在周日，疗养院的访客挤满了土地上的停车设施，并从清晨到傍晚一直沿着车道停车。在经历了两个周日的拥堵和不便之后，该女士在周日于车道上设置了一个障碍物，阻止任何试图进入该团体土地的人使用车道。该团体提出了异议。

该女士提起了适当的诉讼，要求终止该地役权。

在此诉讼中，法院可能会支持哪一方？

zh-choices.A: 该团体，因为地役权的扩大使用不会导致地役权的终止。
zh-choices.B: 该团体，因为该女士使用自力救济（self-help）使其无权获得衡平法上的救济（equitable relief）。
zh-choices.C: 该女士，因为该团体过度扩大了需役地（dominant tenement）的使用。
zh-choices.D: 该女士，因为在车道上停车超出了地役权的范围。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Rights in Real Property - Easements

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：地役权（easement）的使用范围可以随着主从地正常发展而扩大，但只要没有不合理损害或干扰从地，就不能因为“用得更狠”直接终止地役权。

三秒认题路径：

地役权已存在 → 使用变多 → 看是否越界 → 看是否干扰从地 → 不终止

核心法律规则

地役权（easement）是对他人土地的非占有性使用权，所以权利人可以按授予目的使用，也可以进行reasonably necessary 的使用。若是express easement，只要没有被条款限制，使用方式、频率和强度可以随主地（dominant estate）的合理发展而增加。

考场意思：你看到“后面多盖房、车更多、路更挤”，先别急着判无效；先问这是不是主地正常发展造成的扩张。真正的红线不是“变多了”，而是有没有不合理伤害或干扰从地（servient estate）的使用。

核心判例： Restatement (Third) of Property: Servitudes § 4.10 的思路就是：地役权使用可以扩张，只要不对从地造成不合理损害或干扰。

思维导图

先看：这是哪类地役权？
是：express easement，没有写死用途范围。
再看：使用变多了，等于违约吗？
主地合理发展（加建 nursing home、停车需求上升） → 允许扩大使用强度
关键只问：有没有 unreasonably interfere / damage 从地？
本题：没有证据证明不合理损害或干扰成立。
结论：不能终止地役权；最多谈禁令、损害赔偿或自力排除妨害。
所以答案锁定：选 A

考点陷阱

你可能会想：停车把车道堵得很厉害，地主当然可以把地役权“收回”。

但考试真正问的是：司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。 这里即使有干扰，通常也是禁令、赔偿或自力排除妨害，不是直接终止地役权。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 A？

题干使用从每周停车变成更多车辆，只是地役权强度上升；只要没证明对从地造成不合理干扰，就不能终止。

❌ 法律适用 | 自力救济误判

✕ B: 把 self-help 当成放弃起诉，误以为她因此不能再求衡平救济。

❌ 概念混淆 | 扩张即灭失

✕ C: 以为用得更重就自动消灭地役权，其实通常只是看是否越界。

❌ 事实误判 | 停车越界偷换

✕ D: 只抓住 parking，却忽略题干真正争点是能不能终止，而不是单次停车是否合法。

这题建议用什么方法？

先分清“使用扩大”与“权利消灭”不是一回事，再检查是否真的达到不合理干扰。

考场速记

记忆口诀：地役权可以“越用越多”，但不能“越用越没”。先看是否是主地合理发展，再看有没有不合理干扰从地。

B.text: use of self-help denies her the right to equitable relief

D.text: parking on the driveway exceeded the scope of the easement

reason.zh: 决定应依合理必要标准判断使用扩大，而非适用严格限缩的取得地役权规则。

label.zh: 许可的需役地强化使用

reason.en: The zoning-compliant development naturally increases easement traffic without automatically ending the right.

reason.zh: 这是争议中的强化使用，但仍须衡量是否不合理妨害供役地，而非当然终止地役权。

reason.en: Frames whether expanded use is a ground to extinguish the easement rather than merely abate interference.
reason.zh: 界定争议焦点是扩大使用能否作为消灭地役权的理由，而非仅消除妨害。

reason.en: Shows longstanding acceptance of driveway use before the temporary Sunday overflow dispute.
reason.zh: 表明在周日临时拥堵争议前，车道使用长期被接受。

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
Pursuant to a city ordinance, a particular area was zoned for single-family residences. The ordinance allowed a licensed professional, upon acquiring a permit, to maintain an office within one of the residences for use in meeting with clients and other parties in connection with the pursuit of the individual's profession. A licensed psychiatrist purchased a residence within the area zoned for single-family residences. The psychiatrist properly applied for a permit from the zoning commission and established that she met the conditions for granting the permit, but she cannot prove that the denial of the permit would result in an unnecessary hardship to her.
Can the zoning commission properly deny the psychiatrist a permit?

choices.A: No, because she has a vested right in maintaining a home office in her residence.
choices.B: No, because she properly applied for and established her entitlement to the permit.
choices.C: Yes, because she cannot establish that the denial of the permit would result in an unnecessary hardship to her.
choices.D: Yes, because the granting of a permit is a matter within the discretion of the zoning commission.

questions.explanation:
A zoning ordinance is a governmental regulation regarding land use that, for example, limits the use of a particular area to single-family residences. The ordinance may include a special exception permitting a particular future use of property if a special-use permit is obtained. If a property owner complies with the procedures for obtaining a special-use permit and establishes entitlement to that permit (as the psychiatrist did here), the responsible government agency must issue the permit. Therefore, the zoning commission cannot properly deny the psychiatrist a permit.†

If the property owner is denied a permit, procedural due process typically gives the owner the right to appeal the denial to a reviewing entity (eg, a board of zoning appeals).

(Choice A) A vested right regarding a nonconforming use of property exists when, at the time a zoning ordinance takes effect, the property owner is using the property in a manner that violates the ordinance. Here, the psychiatrist did not have a home office when the ordinance was enacted, so she has no vested right in this use.

(Choice C) Proof of unnecessary hardship is not needed to obtain a special-use permit. However, such proof is required to obtain a variance. Under a variance, a local government (often a zoning board) gives a landowner permission to use his/her property in a manner that is not permitted under the zoning ordinance — eg, the use falls outside of a special exception.

(Choice D) The granting of a special-use permit is not subject to the discretion of the zoning commission when, as here, the property owner has established that the conditions for granting the permit have been met.

📌 Educational Objective

A property owner must be granted a special-use permit if the property owner has complied with the procedures for obtaining the permit and has established entitlement to the permit.

📚 References
  • 83 Am. Jur. 2d Zoning and Planning § 814 (2020) (discussing special exceptions or uses).
questions.zh-question:
根据一项城市条例，某一特定区域被划为独栋住宅区。该条例允许有执照的专业人士在获得许可后，在其中一处住宅内设立办公室，用于会见客户及与个人执业相关的其他方。一位有执照的精神科医生在划为独栋住宅的区域内购买了一处住宅。该精神科医生向区域划分委员会正式申请了许可，并证明她满足了授予许可的条件，但她无法证明拒绝该许可将给她带来不必要的困境。

区域划分委员会能否正当拒绝授予该精神科医生许可？

zh-choices.A: 不可以，因为她对其住宅内设立家庭办公室享有既得权利。
zh-choices.B: 不可以，因为她已正式申请并证明了自己有权获得该许可。
zh-choices.C: 可以，因为她无法证明拒绝该许可会给她带来不必要的困境。
zh-choices.D: 可以，因为授予许可属于区域划分委员会的自由裁量权范围。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Rights in Real Property - Government Regulation of Land--Zoning

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：分区条例下的 特殊例外许可（special-use permit），只要申请人按程序申请并证明自己符合条件，政府通常不能再拿 不必要困难（unnecessary hardship） 拒绝。

三秒认题路径：

分区限制 → 特殊例外 → 已达条件 → 不看 hardship → 不能拒绝

核心法律规则

如果市政条例允许某种未来用途以 特殊例外许可（special-use permit） 的方式进入住宅区，考场先看申请人有没有按程序申请，再看有没有证明自己已经满足发证条件。符合条件即应发证（must issue），这不是让机关自由挑人放行的事项。

不必要困难（unnecessary hardship） 是 变更许可（variance） 的门槛，不是特殊例外许可的门槛；所以这题里，女医生说不出 hardship，并不影响她拿 special-use permit。

核心判例： Mohawk Industries v. Carpenter 不适用；本题的控制规则是：特殊例外许可一旦条件满足，主管机关通常必须批准，而不是随意拒绝。

思维导图

先问：题目是在看 特殊例外许可（special-use permit），还是 变更许可（variance）？
特殊例外许可：先查申请程序 → 再查是否证明已满足条件
卡死点：题干已说“properly applied”且“met the conditions”，所以机关不能再拿 hardship 拒绝。
结论：满足条件后，必须发证 → 选 B
变更许可：才会问 unnecessary hardship
这条路才看 hardship；本题事实没有走到这一步。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：既然她不能证明 hardship，那政府就能拒绝。

但考试真正问的是：这是不是 variance；本题是 special-use permit，规则不一样。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

这里还要防一个错觉：特殊例外许可 不是随机关喜欢给不给的恩赐，只要条件满足，命题人就想骗你把它当成自由裁量。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 B？

题干已写明她 properly applied 且 met the conditions，所以 特殊例外许可（special-use permit） 应核发，不能因 hardship 再挡。

❌ 概念混淆 | 既得权误判

✕ A: 把 vested right 乱套到新办公室许可上了。

❌ 法律适用 | hardship套错

✕ C: 把 unnecessary hardship 当成 special-use permit 的门槛。

❌ 事实误判 | 自由裁量偷换

✕ D: 以为委员会还能随便挑人拒绝。

这题建议用什么方法？

先分清是 special-use permit 还是 variance，再看题干有没有已经满足发证条件。

考场速记

记住：special-use permit 看“按程序申请 + 已满足条件”，variance 才看 hardship。
口诀：先分清是“例外许可”还是“变更许可”，别把 hardship 错塞进不该看的门槛里。

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
A restauranteur's friend owned land that included a lake within its boundaries. In a writing, the friend granted the restauranteur a profit that gave her the right to access the lake for the purpose of taking fish from it. For nine years, the restauranteur took fish from the lake and served them in various dishes at her restaurant. During the tenth year, the restauranteur entered negotiations to sell the restaurant to a chef who planned to continue operating the restaurant. The terms of the profit did not address its transferability.
Which of the following would be most important in determining whether the restauranteur could assign her right to remove fish from the lake to the chef as part of the sale of the restaurant?

choices.A: Whether the friend and the restauranteur intended the right to be personal to the restauranteur.
choices.B: Whether the friend granted others the right to take fish from the lake.
choices.C: Whether the friend retained the right to take fish from the lake for himself.
choices.D: Whether the restauranteur recorded the right.

questions.explanation:
Profit

(right to enter another's land & remove natural resources)

Characteristics Transferability Apportionability
Exclusive Unlimited & exclusive right Can be transferred unless profit is personal or contrary to parties' intent If transferable, can be divided unless contrary to parties' intent or burden on servient estate unreasonably increased
Nonexclusive Right limited by quantity, use, or time OR shared with another

A profit (ie, profit à prendre) is a nonpossessory right to enter another's land and remove specific natural resources (eg, oil, gas, minerals, timber, fish). A profit may generally be transferred (eg, assigned) unless the profit is personal or transfer would be contrary to the intent of the parties creating the profit. A profit is personal if the relationship of the parties or other circumstances indicate that it was not intended to be transferable.

This means that the restauranteur's ability to assign her right to remove fish from the lake to the chef turns on whether the friend and restauranteur intended the profit to be personal to the restauranteur (eg, because they were friends). If so, then the restauranteur cannot assign the profit to the chef. But if the profit was intended to benefit the restauranteur's business, then the restauranteur can assign the profit to the chef purchasing her restaurant.

(Choices B & C) When someone else — including the owner of the servient (burdened) estate — enjoys the same right as the profit holder, the profit is nonexclusive. The nonexclusivity of a profit may affect whether the profit holder can divide the profit among other persons, and it may be a factor in determining whether the parties intended the profit to be personal. But it is not itself determinative of whether the profit may be transferred to another.

(Choice D) Recording the profit would protect the restauranteur if the profit is exclusive and the friend subsequently grants a similar right to a third party. However, this would not preclude the profit from being considered personal to the restauranteur and therefore nontransferable.

📌 Educational Objective

A profit—ie, nonpossessory right to enter another's land and remove specific natural resources—may generally be transferred unless the profit is personal or transfer would be contrary to the intent of the parties creating the profit.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Third) of Property (Servitudes) § 4.6 (Am. Law Inst. 2000) (transferability of servitude benefits).
questions.zh-question:
一位餐馆老板的朋友拥有一片土地，其边界内有一个湖。该朋友以书面形式授予了餐馆老板一项取益权（profit），赋予她进入湖泊捕鱼的权利。九年来，该餐馆老板一直在湖中捕鱼，并在她的餐厅里将这些鱼做成各种菜肴。在第十年，该餐馆老板与一位计划继续经营该餐厅的厨师进行谈判，准备出售餐厅。该取益权的条款并未涉及其可转让性。

在决定该餐馆老板是否可以在出售餐厅时，将其从湖中捕鱼的权利转让给厨师，以下哪一项最为重要？

zh-choices.A: 该朋友和餐馆老板是否意图将此权利设定为餐馆老板的属人权。
zh-choices.B: 该朋友是否授予了其他人从湖中捕鱼的权利。
zh-choices.C: 该朋友是否为自己保留了从湖中捕鱼的权利。
zh-choices.D: 该餐馆老板是否对该权利进行了登记。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Rights in Real Property - Easements

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：收益地役权（profit）能不能转让，关键看它是不是只属于当事人本人、也就是是否具有个人性（personal）。

三秒认题路径：

profit → 想转让 → 先看个人性 → 看当事人意图 → 选 A

核心法律规则

收益地役权（profit à prendre）是进入他人土地、取走特定自然资源的非占有性权利（nonpossessory right），比如鱼、木材、矿产。考试上，这种权利一般可以转让（transferable），但如果它是个人性权利（personal），或者转让会违背创设该权利时双方的意图，就不能转给第三人。

所以这题要先问：友人和餐馆老板当初是不是只想把捕鱼权给“这个人本人”，还是想给她经营餐馆用的业务工具。若是前者，就不能把 profit 卖给厨师；若是后者，就可以随餐馆一起转让。

核心判例： Restatement (Third) of Property (Servitudes) § 4.6 锁定规则：servitude benefit 通常可转让，除非当事人意图让它只属于受益人本人。

思维导图

友人 创设 profit 的人
→
餐馆老板 先拿到捕鱼权
→
厨师 想随餐馆受让
→
关键关卡 是否个人性（personal）
→
结论 看双方意图，不看是否录记
先抓：这不是“能不能进地”，而是“这个捕鱼权能不能转给别人”
规则：profit 通常可转让
例外：若权利是个人性（personal），或违背创设时双方意图，就卡死
卡死点：intent 才是决定能否 assignment 的核心
本题落点：问友人和餐馆老板是否打算只给她本人用

考点陷阱

你可能会想：既然友人后来还能给别人类似权利，那就说明餐馆老板的权利一定不能转，或者一定要看有没有 recorded。

但考试真正问的是：谁是这份 profit 的受益人、当初是不是只想给她本人用；司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。这里不是在比谁先登记，也不是在比谁先拿到相同捕鱼权。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 A？

题干 terms of the profit did not address its transferability，所以要看创设时双方是否把这份捕鱼权做成 个人性（personal）；这正决定能不能卖给厨师。

❌ 概念混淆 | 非排他误判

✕ B: 把 granted others 当成转让标准，其实那只是非排他线索，不是本题核心。

❌ 事实误判 | 自留权偷换

✕ C: 友人自己也能捕鱼，不等于这份 profit 不能转，题干没把“自留”写成决定条件。

❌ 法律适用 | 登记效力错位

✕ D: recorded the right 只影响对抗第三人，不回答能不能 assignment。

这题建议用什么方法？

先看是否默认可转，再问有没有“个人性”这个例外，最后回到双方创设时的意图。

考场速记

口诀：profit 默认能转；一旦题干在问“是不是只给这个人”，立刻抓 personal / intent，不是抓登记、不是抓别人有没有同类权利。

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
A building with 40 residential units is owned by a corporation and operated as a cooperative. Each resident is a shareholder in the corporation as well as its tenant pursuant to a lease that is subject to the mortgage on the building. Each tenant is assessed an annual fee to cover part of the corporation's taxes, maintenance expenses, and mortgage obligation. Through poor management by the corporation's board of directors, the corporation failed to raise sufficient funds to pay the mortgage obligation. The bank that holds the mortgage on the building has begun foreclosure proceedings. A resident of the building who paid the annual assessment fee and is not a member of the board of directors has sought a declaratory judgment that a buyer at the foreclosure sale takes the building subject to her lease.
The applicable jurisdiction has not adopted a statute that addresses this situation.
How should the court rule?

choices.A: Against the resident, because she is personally liable for the mortgage obligation as a shareholder of the corporation.
choices.B: Against the resident, because the lease is subject to the mortgage on the building.
choices.C: For the resident, because she is not a member of the corporation's board of directors.
choices.D: For the resident, because she paid her annual assessment fee.

questions.explanation:
Main types of common-interest communities
Property owners' association
  • Property owners must, as consequence of property ownership, belong to association & pay dues to it or
  • Property owners in real-estate development must pay for use/maintenance of property held in common by individual owners, but association membership is optional
Condominium
  • Created by state statutes by filing declaration (or master deed) & plat with recording office in condominium's locality
  • Declaration & bylaws set out rights & obligations of unit owners & fix shares for allocating expenses, taxes, voting rights
  • Each owner is responsible for his/her own mortgage
Cooperative
  • Typically consists of land & one or more buildings owned by corporation that leases individual residential units to shareholders
  • Resident is tenant who also owns one or more shares of stock in corporation & is prohibited from transferring interest separately from lease
  • Cooperative has blanket mortgage

A cooperative is a common-interest community that typically consists of land and one or more buildings owned by a corporation that leases individual residential units to its shareholders. Unlike a condominium, in which each unit owner is responsible for his/her own mortgage, a cooperative has a blanket mortgage that generally has priority over occupancy leases.

Since the leases are subject to the mortgage on the cooperative, a default on the blanket mortgage can result in foreclosure proceedings on the property, which in turn can terminate all leases. Therefore, the buyer at a foreclosure sale will not take the building subject to a resident's lease.

(Choice A) A shareholder in a cooperative is not personally liable for the cooperative's debts.

(Choice C) Members of a corporation's board of directors may incur liability for the board's poor management of the corporation.* However, this does not prevent the resident from suffering the consequences of the corporation's default on its mortgage obligation.

*However, many courts apply the business-judgment rule to insulate a director or an officer from liability for an honest but mistaken business decision.

(Choice D) Although the resident has paid her annual assessment fee, which includes her share of the mortgage obligation on the building, she can nevertheless lose her right to occupy her residential unit if the bank forecloses on that mortgage.

📌 Educational Objective

Unlike a condominium, in which each unit owner is responsible for his/her own mortgage, a cooperative has a blanket mortgage that generally has priority over occupancy leases. A default on that mortgage can therefore result in foreclosure proceedings on the property, which in turn can terminate all leases.
questions.zh-question:
一栋拥有40个住宅单元的建筑由一家公司所有，并作为合作社（cooperative）运营。根据一份受该建筑抵押权约束的租赁合同，每位住户既是公司的股东，也是其承租人。每位承租人都被征收年度费用，以支付公司的部分税款、维护费用和抵押贷款债务。由于公司董事会管理不善，公司未能筹集到足够资金来偿付抵押贷款债务。持有该建筑抵押权的银行已启动止赎程序。一位已支付年度评估费且非董事会成员的住户，请求法院作出宣告性判决，认定止赎拍卖中的买家在购得该建筑时，须受其租赁合同的约束。

相关司法管辖区并未通过解决此种情况的法规。

法院应如何裁决？

zh-choices.A: 裁决住户败诉，因为作为公司股东，她个人对抵押贷款债务承担责任。
zh-choices.B: 裁决住户败诉，因为租赁合同受该建筑的抵押权约束。
zh-choices.C: 裁决住户胜诉，因为她不是公司董事会成员。
zh-choices.D: 裁决住户胜诉，因为她已支付其年度评估费用。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Rights in Real Property - Covenants Running With The Land

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：合作公寓（cooperative）里的 blanket mortgage 违约后，拍卖买受人能不能摆脱原住户的占有租约；答案是通常不能保住租约。

三秒认题路径：

合作公寓 → 共同抵押 → 抵押优先 → 违约拍卖 → 租约被终止

核心法律规则

cooperative（合作公寓） 的考场意思：住户既是股东也是承租人，但房屋通常由公司统一背着一笔 blanket mortgage（整体抵押）。这笔抵押一般优先于住户的 occupancy lease（居住租约），所以一旦公司违约并进入 foreclosure（止赎），租约可能一起被清掉。

所以这题不是在问“住户有没有交会费”，而是在问“拍卖后买家能不能继承这份租约”。在 cooperative 结构里，通常不能，除非题目另给了相反的法定例外。

核心判例： Mohawk Industries v. Carpenter 不适用于本题；本题控制逻辑是 cooperative 的 blanket mortgage 优先于 occupancy lease，因此止赎买受人通常不受该租约约束。

思维导图

先看产权结构：这是 cooperative，还是 condominium？
合作公寓 公司持有整栋楼 + 住户持股并租住单元
关键后果：blanket mortgage 通常压过住户租约
违约与止赎 公司未能支付整体抵押 → 银行开始 foreclosure
卡死点：买受人不必承接被抵押压住的 occupancy lease
错误直觉 已交年度 fee / 不是董事会成员 / 只是股东
都不改变：租约仍可能随止赎被终止
结论：拍卖买受人一般 不会 受该租约约束 → 选 B

考点陷阱

你可能会想：既然住户每年都交了管理费，还不是董事会成员，那买家应该接着让她住下去。

但考试真正问的是：公司层面的 blanket mortgage 违约后，拍卖买受人能不能摆脱被抵押压住的租约。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。 同理，这里看的是抵押优先顺位，不看住户有没有“已经付钱”。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 B？

题干的 lease is subject to the mortgage 说明租约排在整体抵押之后；公司一旦止赎，买受人通常不受该租约约束。

❌ 概念混淆 | 股东责任误判

✕ A: 把shareholder当成要替公司债务买单的人。

❌ 事实误判 | 董事身份偷换

✕ C: 只盯着“不是董事”这点，忽略了租约本身仍受抵押约束。

❌ 法律适用 | 交费不等于保住租约

✕ D: 以为交了annual assessment fee 就能挡住止赎后果。

这题建议用什么方法？

先认结构，再看抵押顺位；看到 cooperative + blanket mortgage，就优先想到租约可能被止赎一起清掉。

考场速记

记住一句：cooperative 看整体抵押，condominium 看各自房贷。 题目一旦出现 cooperative + foreclosure，先问租约有没有被 blanket mortgage 压住。

如果以后再遇到中间上诉题，再背这个口诀：In Certain Circumstances, An Appeal Can Be Made Prematurely；但本题不是上诉题，核心就是“抵押优先，租约可能被清”。

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
A fan had a season ticket for the local team's hockey games at an arena (Section B, Row 12, Seat 16). During the intermission between the first and second periods of a game between the local team and the visiting team, the fan solicited signatures for a petition urging that the coach of the local team be fired.
The arena and the local team are owned by a privately owned entity. As evidenced by many prominently displayed signs, the entity prohibits all solicitations anywhere within the arena at any time and in any manner. The entity notified the fan to cease her solicitation of signatures.
The fan continued to seek signatures on her petition during the local team's next three home games at the arena. Each time, the entity notified the fan to cease such solicitation. The fan announced her intention to seek signatures on her petition again during the local team's next home game at the arena. The entity wrote a letter informing the fan that her season ticket was canceled and tendering a refund for the unused portion. The fan refused the tender and brought an appropriate action to establish the right to attend all home games.
In this action, for whom will the court decide?

choices.A: The entity, because it has a right and obligation to control activities on realty it owns and has invited the public to visit.
choices.B: The entity, because the fan's ticket to hockey games created only a license.
choices.C: The fan, because, having paid value for the ticket, her right to be present cannot be revoked.
choices.D: The fan, because she was not committing a nuisance by her activities.

questions.explanation:
Licenses
Definition
  • Revocable privilege to enter & use another's land for specific purpose
Creation
  • Orally, in writing, or by another act demonstrating licensor's intent to create license
Termination
  • At any time upon revocation by licensor
  • Automatically upon (1) death of licensor or licensee or (2) conveyance of licensed property

A ticket to an event is a license that creates a limited right for the ticketholder (licensee) to enter and use the venue for a specific purpose. The license is revocable at any time and for any lawful reason, including failure to comply with any conditions that the owner of the venue (licensor) has placed on the ticketholder (as seen here). This is true even though the ticketholder paid value for the ticket. However, the owner may be required to pay damages for revoking the license (eg, refunding the unused portion of the ticket) (Choice C).

(Choice A) Even if the entity has a duty to control activities on property it owns and has invited the public to visit, that duty would arise out of a need to protect the health and safety of the public. Prohibiting solicitations does not fall within protection of health and safety, so this rationale would not justify the entity's revocation of the ticket.

(Choice D) A nuisance arises from a person's activities on his/her own land, so the fan could not commit a nuisance on the entity's property. But the entity need not prove that the fan was committing a nuisance to revoke her license to attend hockey games.

📌 Educational Objective

A license (eg, ticket to an event) is revocable at any time and for any lawful reason. But if the licensee paid value for the license, the licensor may be required to pay damages for revoking it.

📚 References
  • Yarde Metals, Inc. v. New England Patriots Ltd. P'ship, 834 N.E.2d 1233, 1236 (Mass. App. 2005) (upholding revocation of season tickets based on licensee's misconduct).

一名球迷拥有一张本地冰球队在某场馆比赛的季票（B区12排16座）。在本地球队与客队的一场比赛的第一节和第二节中场休息期间，该球迷为一份要求解雇本地球队教练的请愿书征集签名。

该场馆和本地球队均由一家私营实体所有。正如许多醒目张贴的告示所示，该实体禁止在场馆内任何地方、任何时间以任何方式进行任何征集活动。该实体通知该球迷停止其征集签名的活动。

在接下来的三场本地球队主场比赛中，该球迷继续在场馆内为其请愿书征集签名。每次，该实体都通知该球迷停止此类征集活动。该球迷宣布她打算在本地球队的下一场主场比赛中再次为其请愿书征集签名。该实体致信通知该球迷，其季票已被取消，并主动提出退还未使用部分的票款。该球迷拒绝了退款提议，并提起了适当的诉讼，以确立其参加所有主场比赛的权利。

在此诉讼中，法院将判决哪一方胜诉？

zh-choices.A: 该实体，因为它有权力和义务控制其拥有并邀请公众参观的不动产上的活动。
zh-choices.B: 该实体，因为该球迷的冰球比赛门票仅创设了一项许可。
zh-choices.C: 该球迷，因为她已为门票支付了对价，其到场的权利不可被撤销。
zh-choices.D: 该球迷，因为她的活动并未构成妨害。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Rights in Real Property - Easements

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：球票（ticket）到底是可随时撤销的许可（license），还是不能轻易赶走人的更强权利。

三秒认题路径：

球票进场 → 私人场馆 → 禁止传单 → 反复违规 → 撤销许可

核心法律规则

许可（license）是允许你为特定目的进入并使用他人土地的可撤销权利（revocable privilege），所以球票一般只给你“进去看球”的权利，不给你永久占用权。

许可人可以在任何合法理由下撤销许可，尤其当持票人不遵守场馆规则时；就算你已经付了票钱，paid value 也不把许可变成不可撤销的权利。

但如果持票人已经付了价款，撤销方可能要承担损害赔偿，比如退掉未使用部分的票款；这影响的是钱，不影响能不能立刻赶人。

核心判例： Yarde Metals, Inc. v. New England Patriots Ltd. P'ship - 赛事票可因持票人不当行为被撤销，说明球票通常只是许可。

思维导图

球票持有人
season ticket
→
私人场馆实体
licensor
→
只给许可
license
→
反复被警告仍继续传单
→
可撤销
球票能不能让她继续进场？
先看：这是 许可（license），不是永久财产权。
再看：场馆已明示禁止任何 solicitation，而且她反复违令。
卡死点：revocable at any time，付过钱也不阻止撤销。
结论：实体可取消票证；最多考虑退未用票款，不是继续入场权。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：她已经付了季票价款，而且场馆对公众开放，所以应该不能随便取消。

但考试真正问的是：这张票给的是不是许可（license），以及许可人能不能因为合法场规被违反而撤销。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 B？

题干 season ticket 只给她进入场馆看球的权利，属于许可（license）；她又反复违反场馆禁令，所以实体可以撤销。

❌ 概念混淆 | 公共场所误判

✕ A: 把“欢迎公众”当成不能撤票，但私人场馆仍可管制入场行为。

❌ 法律适用 | 付费不可撤销

✕ C: 以为 paid value 就锁死权利，其实最多影响退款，不保住许可。

❌ 事实误判 | 噪音条件偷换

✕ D: 把 nuisance 当成撤销门槛，但场馆根本不用先证明她构成侵权。

这题建议用什么方法？

先认权利性质，再看是否已被场馆明确撤销；付费不是护身符。

考场速记

记住这句：球票 = 许可（license），一般可撤销；paid value 只可能带来退款，不会把你变成“不能赶走”的权利人。

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
A woman owned two adjacent parcels, Lot 1 and Lot 2. Lot 1 fronts on a poor unpaved public road, while Lot 2 fronts a paved major highway. Fifteen years ago, the woman conveyed Lot 1 to her son "together with a right-of-way 25 feet wide over the east side of Lot 2 to [the major highway]." At that time, Lot 1 was improved with a 10-unit motel.
Ten years ago, the woman died. Her will devised Lot 2 "to my son for life, remainder to my daughter." Five years ago, the son executed an instrument in the proper form of a deed, purporting to convey Lot 1 and Lot 2 to his friend in fee simple. The friend then enlarged the motel to 12 units. Six months ago, the son died and the daughter took possession of Lot 2. She brought an appropriate action to enjoin the friend from using the right-of-way.
In this action, who should prevail?

choices.A: The daughter, because merger extinguished the easement.
choices.B: The daughter, because the friend has overburdened the easement.
choices.C: The friend, because he has an easement by necessity.
choices.D: The friend, because he has the easement granted by the woman to the son.

questions.explanation:
Easement (over Lot 2)
Active
Suspended (same present owner + future interest)
Active
Lot 1(Dominant Estate)
Woman
Son
(fee simple)
Friend
(fee simple)
Lot 2(Servient Estate)
Woman
Son
(life estate)
Friend
(life estate
pur autre vie)
Daughter
(fee simple)
Daughter has future interest

An easement is generally terminated by merger when the dominant and servient estates are united in common ownership. But merger does not occur—and the easement does not terminate—if there are any future interests (or other outstanding interests) in either estate. If there is a future interest, use of the easement is suspended until the future-interest holder becomes entitled to possession.

Here, the woman conveyed Lot 1 (dominant estate) to her son, together with an easement to cross Lot 2 (servient estate) to access the highway. When the woman died, her will devised Lot 2 to her son for life, remainder to her daughter. Because the daughter had a future interest entitling her to possession of Lot 2 once the son dies, the easement was suspended during the son's lifetime—not terminated (Choice A).

The son then purported to convey Lots 1 and 2 to the friend in fee simple. But since the son had only a life estate in Lot 2, that is all he could convey to the friend. So when the son died, the daughter's future interest vested and she became entitled to possession of Lot 2. At that time, the easement over Lot 2 became active. And since the friend owns Lot 1 in fee simple, he now holds the easement.

(Choice B) Normal development of the dominant estate—including a change in the intensity or frequency of use—does not overburden the servient estate. Therefore, the friend did not overburden the easement by increasing the motel from 10 to 12 units.

(Choice C) An easement by necessity only arises when the easement is strictly necessary for the use and enjoyment of property—eg, when

  • property cannot be accessed by a public road (not seen here).
📌 Educational Objective

An easement cannot be terminated by merger if there are any future interests (or other outstanding interests) in the dominant or servient estate. Where there is a future interest, use of the easement is suspended until the future-interest holder becomes entitled to possession.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Third) of Property: Servitudes § 7.5 (Am. Law Inst. 2000) (termination by merger).
questions.zh-question:
一名女性拥有两块相邻地块，地块1和地块2。地块1临近一条状况不佳的未铺砌公共道路，而地块2则临近一条已铺砌的主要公路。十五年前，该女性将其地块1转让给了她的儿子，“并附带一条25英尺宽、穿过地块2东侧通往[主要公路]的通行权。”当时，地块1上建有一家拥有10个单元的汽车旅馆。

十年前，该女性去世。她的遗嘱将地块2遗赠给“我的儿子终身保有，剩余权益归我的女儿。”五年前，儿子以适当的契约形式签署了一份文书，意图将地块1和地块2的完全所有权转让给他的朋友。之后，该朋友将汽车旅馆扩大到12个单元。六个月前，儿子去世，女儿占有了地块2。她提起了适当的诉讼，请求禁止该朋友使用该通行权。

在此诉讼中，谁应胜诉？

zh-choices.A: 女儿，因为混同消灭了地役权。
zh-choices.B: 女儿，因为该朋友对地役权的使用超出了负担。
zh-choices.C: 朋友，因为他拥有必要地役权。
zh-choices.D: 朋友，因为他拥有该女性授予其儿子的地役权。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Rights in Real Property - Easements

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：地役权（easement）会不会因为合并（merger）消灭，还是因为受让人手里还有未来权益而只是先暂停使用。

三秒认题路径：

原授予地役权 → 后来有未来权益 → 不是终止 → 只是暂停 → 未来权益成熟后恢复

核心法律规则

本题只抓这一条

地役权（easement，考场意思：别人给你一条通行权）通常只有在主从地完全并入同一现占有人时，才会因合并（merger，考场意思：同一个人同时拿到两块地）而终止。

但如果主地或从地上还有未来权益（future interest，考场意思：以后才轮到别人拿到完整占有），就不会消灭，而是先暂停使用，等未来权益人真正拿到占有后再恢复。

所以本题不看“后来谁觉得这条路更顺眼”，只看当下有没有未来权益卡着合并。

核心判例： Restatement (Third) of Property: Servitudes § 7.5 —— 有未来权益时，合并不成立，地役权不灭，只是暂停。

思维导图

先问：这条地役权有没有被“合并”真正消灭？
第1关：主地 Lot 1 和从地 Lot 2 是否被同一现占有人完全合并？
看事实：女方先把 Lot 1 连同穿越 Lot 2 的通行权授给儿子；她死后，Lot 2 变成“儿子终身享有 + 女儿余留继承”。
卡死点：女儿有未来权益，合并不成立，地役权不终止，只会暂停。
第2关：儿子后来把两块地都转给朋友，能不能把这条通行权“带走”？
答案：可以。儿子只能转走自己有的权利；等儿子死后，女儿才取得 Lot 2 的占有，地役权重新变成有效状态。
结论：朋友继续享有原来女方授予儿子的地役权，所以女儿不能禁用该通行权。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：既然后来 Lot 1 和 Lot 2 都进了儿子手里，merger 应该已经把地役权灭掉了。

但考试真正问的是：当时 Lot 2 还有女儿的未来权益卡着，所以不是永久消灭，而是先暂停，等女儿真正取得占有后再恢复。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，不是「表面上看起来有没有暂时重合过」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 D？

题干给的是女方对儿子作出的原始授予，且儿子死前 Lot 2 上一直有女儿的未来权益，所以合并没有真正消灭这条通行权；女儿取得占有后，朋友仍可继续使用。

❌ 概念混淆 | 合并失效误判

✕ A: 把merger想成一碰就灭，漏掉了女儿的未来权益。

❌ 事实误判 | 扩建当成过重

✕ B: 12个单元只是正常扩张，不是把地役权用坏了。

❌ 法律适用 | 必要地役权套错

✕ C: 题目已有明示授予，别硬套necessity。

这题建议用什么方法？

先看原始授予，再查有没有未来权益卡住合并；只要没真正终止，就先默认地役权继续活着。

考场速记

记忆口诀：“有未来权益，合并不灭；先暂停，后恢复。” 这类题先找明示授予，再找有没有余留、终身、未来权益把合并拦住。
