questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
A landlord orally leased a commercial building to a tenant for a 10-year term, which ended one year ago. At the beginning of the lease term, the tenant installed numerous appliances in the building as well as a large air-conditioning system. The tenant alone paid for these items; they were installed with the landlord's permission and were used for the tenant's commercial enterprise.
At the end of the lease term, the tenant failed to vacate the premises in a timely manner and continued to pay rent while remaining in possession for another four months. Before vacating the building at the end of the fourth month, the tenant removed the appliances and the air-conditioning system that he had installed, causing no damage to the building.
Was the removal by the tenant proper?

choices.A: No, because he was a holdover tenant.
choices.B: No, because the lease was oral.
choices.C: Yes, because they were accessions.
choices.D: Yes, because they were trade fixtures.

questions.explanation:
Removal of trade fixtures

10-year lease begins
Tenant installs items for his enterprise
Lease ends; tenant stays & pays rent
Tenant removes items without damage
Tenant vacates building
Tenancy for years
Periodic tenancy
Removal allowed Removal prohibited

A tenant can remove trade fixtures—items the tenant attached to real property for use in his/her trade or business—without the landlord's consent if:

  • the removal will not substantially harm the property (eg, will not degrade the building's structural integrity) and
  • the items are removed before, or within a reasonable time after, the lease terminates.

Since a periodic tenancy has no defined end date, it continues until either the landlord or tenant gives express notice to terminate it. This tenancy can be created by agreement (eg, a written lease) or by implication (eg, when the tenant continues to pay, and the landlord continues to accept, rent after a prior lease has ended).

Here, the appliances and air-conditioning system are trade fixtures since the tenant installed them for use in his commercial enterprise. And though the tenant's oral 10-year lease ended one year ago, he then initiated a periodic tenancy by continuing to use the premises and pay rent for another four months. And since the tenant removed the trade fixtures before the end of the fourth month (before the tenancy terminated) and caused no damage to the building, the removal was proper.

(Choice A) Although he was a holdover tenant—a tenant who entered a valid lease and then stayed past the end of the lease term—he became a periodic tenant when he kept possession of the premises and continued to pay rent. Therefore, he had the right to remove the trade fixtures before the periodic tenancy ended.

(Choice B) Since the 10-year lease was oral and could not be performed within a year, it was unenforceable under the statute of frauds. But the landlord and tenant then formed a periodic tenancy that (1) was not subject to the statute of frauds and (2) was still in effect when the tenant removed the trade fixtures. Therefore, the removal was proper (regardless of the prior oral lease).

(Choice C) Accessions are items that are so attached to other property that they cannot be removed without causing substantial damage. Here, the appliances and air-conditioning system were not accessions since they were removed without damaging the building. But had they been accessions, removal would have been improper.

📌 Educational Objective

Trade fixtures—items attached to real property by a tenant for use in his/her trade or business—can be removed without the landlord's consent if (1) the removal occurs before, or within a reasonable time after, the lease ends and (2) the removal will not substantially harm the property.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Second) of Prop.: Landlord & Tenant § 1.5 (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (periodic tenancy).
  • Restatement (Second) of Prop.: Landlord & Tenant §§ 12.2–12.3 (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (restoration after removal of trade fixtures).
questions.zh-question:
房东将一栋商业建筑口头出租给租户，租期为10年，该租期已于一年前结束。在租期开始时，租户在建筑物内安装了许多电器以及一个大型空调系统。这些物品由租户单独支付费用；它们是在房东的许可下安装的，并用于租户的商业企业。

在租期结束时，租户未能及时腾空房产，并继续支付租金，同时又占有了四个月。在第四个月末腾空建筑物之前，租户拆除了他安装的电器和空调系统，没有对建筑物造成任何损坏。

租户的拆除行为是否适当？

zh-choices.A: 不适当，因为他是一个逾期占用租户。
zh-choices.B: 不适当，因为租约是口头的。
zh-choices.C: 适当，因为它们是添附物。
zh-choices.D: 适当，因为它们是营业定着物。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Rights in Real Property - Fixtures

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：承租人安装的贸易装置（trade fixtures）能不能在租期结束前或合理时间内拆走，且拆除不能明显损坏房屋。

三秒认题路径：

租客装设备 → 商业用途 → 先看租期 → 再看损坏 → 能拆就对

核心法律规则

承租人为自己的生意或贸易安装的贸易装置（trade fixtures），一般可以拆走；考场意思：这是租客带来的经营工具，不是自动送给房东的房屋一部分。

但有两个卡点：一是要在租约终止前，或终止后的合理时间内拆；二是拆除不能对房屋造成重大损害。只要这两点过关，房东通常不能拦。

本题里，设备是租客自己出钱装的，服务于商业经营，而且拆掉时没有损坏建筑，所以结论就是可以取回。

核心判例：本题依照传统 fixture 规则和租客取回权逻辑：商业用途的可拆附着物，只要不伤房、且时间上不拖太久，就能带走。

思维导图

起点
租客出钱安装
为自己的商业经营
租期结束
别被“留租”带跑：
先看是否已形成继续占有
随后四个月
继续付租并占有
→ 实际上是继续的租赁状态
搬走前
拆走设备
无建筑损坏
结论
可拆
贸易装置保留取回权

考点陷阱

你可能会想：他是holdover，是不是就不能拆了。

但考试真正问的是：这些东西是不是贸易装置（trade fixtures），以及拆的时候有没有伤到房屋。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

也就是说，续住并不自动抹掉租客对商业装置的取回权；真正决定答案的是“用途 + 时间 + 是否损坏”。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 D？

设备是租客为商业经营安装的trade fixtures，且在离开前拆除、没有损坏建筑，所以可以带走。

❌ 概念混淆 | 留租误判

✕ A: 只盯着holdover，忘了继续付租后他仍保有取回权。

❌ 法律适用 | 书面要求误判

✕ B: 把口头租约的瑕疵，硬套到后来形成的占有关系上。

❌ 事实误判 | 结构损坏偷换

✕ C: 这里不是accessions，因为拆下来没有把房子弄坏。

这题建议用什么方法？

先抓“商业用途附着物”再查“是否及时拆除、是否损坏房屋”，不要被留租事实带偏。

考场速记

记住这句：trade fixtures = 租客为生意装的东西，能拆；前提是“及时拆 + 不伤房”。

下次看到“商用设备 + 退租拆走 + 没有损坏”，优先想“可以带走”，不要先被租约期限吓住。

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
A man conveyed his house to his wife for life, remainder to his only child, a son by a previous marriage. Thereafter, the man died, devising his entire estate to his son.
The wife later removed a light fixture in the dining room of the house and replaced it with a chandelier that was one of her family heirlooms. She then informed her nephew and her late husband's son that after her death, the chandelier should be removed from the dining room and replaced with the former light fixture, which she had stored in the basement.
The wife died and under her will bequeathed her entire estate to her nephew. She also named the nephew as the personal representative of her estate. After the nephew, in his capacity as personal representative, removed the chandelier and replaced it with the original light fixture shortly after the wife's death, the son sued to have the chandelier reinstalled.
Who will likely prevail?

choices.A: The nephew, because he had the right to remove the chandelier within a reasonable time after the wife's death.
choices.B: The nephew, because of the doctrine of accession.
choices.C: The son, because a personal representative can remove only trade fixtures from real property.
choices.D: The son, because the chandelier could not be legally removed after the death of the wife.

questions.explanation:
Tenant annexed (ie, attached) chattel to the land
No
Cannot remove
Yes
Tenant did not intend to permanently annex chattel
No
Cannot remove
Yes
Chattel can be removed without substantial damage
No
Cannot remove
Yes
Can remove within a reasonable time

When a life tenant, the holder of a life estate, annexes (ie, attaches) a chattel to the property, the life tenant—or his/her personal representative—has the right to remove the chattel within a reasonable time after the estate ends if:

  • the life tenant did not intend for the annexation to be permanent and
  • the chattel can be removed without substantial damage to the property or the chattel.

Here, the man conveyed a life estate to his wife. She installed a chandelier (a chattel) in the home but did not intend the installation to be permanent. Accordingly, when she died and a fee simple passed to the son, the nephew, as the wife's personal representative, had the right to remove the chandelier within a reasonable time after her death.

(Choice B) The doctrine of accession does not apply here because the chandelier can be removed without substantial damage to the property or the chattel.

(Choice C) A life tenant's right to remove annexed chattel is not limited to trade fixtures (eg, store counters installed by a commercial tenant).

(Choice D) The nephew could legally remove the chandelier, which contradicts the premise of this answer choice.

📌 Educational Objective

A life tenant (or his/her personal representative) may remove an annexed chattel within a reasonable time after the life estate ends if (1) the life tenant did not intend to permanently annex the chattel and (2) its removal will not cause substantial damage.

📚 References
  • Restatement (First) of Property § 122 (Am. Law Inst. 1936) (life tenant's right to remove fixtures).
  • Restatement (Second) of Property: Landlord & Tenant § 12.2 (Am. Law Inst. 1977) (tenant's rights and obligations as to physical changes to the property).
questions.zh-question:
一名男子将其房屋转让给其妻子，授予其终身保有权，剩余权益归其前次婚姻所生的独子。此后，该男子去世，并通过遗嘱将其全部遗产赠与其子。

后来，该妻子移除了房屋餐厅的一盏灯具，并换上了一件作为其家族传家宝的水晶吊灯。随后，她告知其外甥和已故丈夫的儿子，在她去世后，应将该水晶吊灯从餐厅移除，并换回她存放在地下室的原有灯具。

该妻子去世，并根据其遗嘱，将其全部遗产遗赠给其外甥。她还指定其外甥为其遗产的个人代表。在妻子去世后不久，其外甥以个人代表的身份移除了水晶吊灯并换回了原来的灯具，其后，儿子提起诉讼，要求重新安装该水晶吊灯。

谁可能胜诉？

zh-choices.A: 外甥，因为他有权在妻子去世后的合理时间内移除该水晶吊灯。
zh-choices.B: 外甥，因为添附原则。
zh-choices.C: 儿子，因为个人代表只能从不动产上移除营业定着物。
zh-choices.D: 儿子，因为在妻子去世后，该水晶吊灯不能被合法移除。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Rights in Real Property - Fixtures

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：终身承租人（life tenant）安装的附着动产（fixture/chattel），在死亡后能不能由其遗产个人代表（personal representative）在合理时间内拆走。

三秒认题路径：

先看谁装的 → 是否永久附着 → 能否无损拆除 → 死后是否及时拆 → 能否保留/移走

核心法律规则

只背这条就够做题

如果终身承租人（life tenant）把 chattel 附着到房屋上，只要他/她当时没有打算永久附着（no intent to permanently annex），而且拆除不会造成重大损害（substantial damage），那这个东西可以在生命地产结束后（after the life estate ends）的合理时间（reasonable time）内拆走。考试上这代表：个人代表（personal representative）也可以接着做这个拆除动作。

核心判例： Restatement (First) of Property § 122 和 Restatement (Second) of Property: Landlord & Tenant § 12.2 一起锁定：可拆、无重大损害、合理时间内拆。

思维导图

先问：这个 chandelier 是不是被 life tenant 以“可拆”的方式装上去的？
YES 继续看两个门槛：
1 她当时没想永久附着；
2 拆掉不会伤房子或 chandelier。
两关都过 → 死后合理时间内可拆 → 个人代表胜
NO 只要任一关不过，就不能移走，房屋所有人/未来权益人赢。
本题落点 题干说她只是换灯具，且死后马上由 nephew 拆回去，正好命中“可拆 + 合理时间”。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：她一死，房子就归后续权益人，chandelier 也该跟着留下。

但考试真正问的是：这盏灯到底是“已经变成房屋的一部分”，还是仍然保留可拆的 fixture 解除权。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的东西有没有先被换上去」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 A？

题干给出她生前安装 chandelier 且未显示永久附着；她死后 nephew 作为 personal representative 及时拆回，正落在合理时间内可拆这条规则上。

❌ 概念混淆 | 规则源头误判

✕ B: 把 doctrine of accession 当成必然归屋主，忽略了这里本来就能拆。

❌ 法律适用 | 交易场景误搬

✕ C: 误把 trade fixtures 的限制套到 life tenant 身上。

❌ 事实误判 | 死后禁拆偷换

✕ D: 直接说死后不能拆，和题干里“死后马上拆回去”这组事实正面冲突。

这题建议用什么方法？

先抓谁有拆除权，再看是否永久附着与是否无重大损害，最后只问“死后是否仍在合理时间内”。

考场速记

记住一句：life tenant 装上去的东西，不一定永远留下；只要不打算永久附着且拆除不致重大损害，死后也可能由 personal representative 在合理时间内取走。

这题的口袋口诀：can remove within a reasonable time。

question_analysis.skill_tested: Apply life tenant annexed chattel removal

keywords.text: for life, remainder to his only child

reason.en: Creates the life tenant status that triggers the removal-right analysis.
reason.zh: 确立终身租户身份，从而触发动产移除权分析。

keywords.text: chandelier that was one of her family heirlooms

reason.en: Shows the installed item was personal property, not a permanent improvement.
reason.zh: 表明安装物为个人财产，而非永久性改良。

keywords.text: after her death, the chandelier should be removed

reason.en: Signals the wife did not intend the chandelier to become a permanent fixture.
reason.zh: 表明妻子无意使吊灯成为永久附着物。

reason.en: Identifies who may exercise the life tenant's removal right after death.
reason.zh: 确定终身租户死后谁可行使移除权。

label.zh: 地产权终止后的合理期间

reason.en: Tests whether removal occurred within the permitted post-death window.
reason.zh: 检验移除是否在允许的死后合理期间内完成。

reason.en: Supports that removal could occur without substantial damage or loss.
reason.zh: 支持移除不会造成重大损害或损失。

A.text: within a reasonable time after the wife's death

reason.en: States the correct timing limit for a life tenant's representative to remove annexed chattel.
reason.zh: 说明终身租户代表移除附着动产的正确时限。

reason.en: Invokes a different rule that does not govern removable non-permanent annexations.
reason.zh: 援引不适用于可移除非永久附着的不同规则。

reason.en: Wrongly narrows removal rights to commercial trade fixtures only.
reason.zh: 错误地将移除权限限缩至商业营业附着物。

D.text: could not be legally removed after the death of the wife

reason.en: Denies the recognized exception allowing timely removal after the life estate ends.
reason.zh: 否认终身地产权终止后允许及时移除的例外规则。

highlights.text: for life, remainder to his only child

reason.en: Establishes the wife as life tenant, making the fixture-removal exception available.
reason.zh: 确立妻子为终身租户，从而适用动产移除例外规则。

highlights.text: chandelier that was one of her family heirlooms

reason.en: Indicates the annexed item was personal property rather than a intended permanent fixture.
reason.zh: 表明附着物为个人财产，而非意图永久附着的物件。

highlights.text: after her death, the chandelier should be removed

reason.en: Direct evidence the life tenant did not permanently annex the chandelier to the land.
reason.zh: 直接证明终身租户未将吊灯永久附着于土地。

highlights.text: removed the chandelier and replaced it with the original light fixture shortly after the wife's death

reason.en: Shows the nephew exercised the removal right promptly and without substantial damage.
reason.zh: 表明侄子及时行使移除权且未造成重大损害。

highlights.text: the son sued to have the chandelier reinstalled

reason.zh: 界定剩余权人能否强制保留已移除动产的争议。

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
An architect and a developer own adjacent parcels of land. On each of their parcels was a low-rise office building. The two office buildings were of the same height.
Last year the developer decided to demolish the low-rise office building on her parcel and to erect a new high-rise office building of substantially greater height on her parcel as permitted by the zoning and building ordinances. She secured all the governmental approvals necessary to pursue her project.
As the developer's new building was in the course of construction, the architect realized that the shadows it would create would place the architect's building in such deep shade that the rent she could charge for space in her building would be substantially reduced.
The architect brought an appropriate action against the developer to enjoin the construction in order to eliminate the shadow problem and for damages. The architect presented uncontroverted evidence that her evaluation as to the impact of the shadow on the fair rental value of her building was correct. There is no statute or ordinance (other than the building and zoning ordinances) that is applicable to the issues before the court.
How should the court rule?

choices.A: Award the architect damages measured by the loss of rental value, but not an injunction.
choices.B: Grant judgment for the developer, because she had secured all the necessary governmental approvals for the new building.
choices.C: Grant judgment for the developer, because the architect has no legal right to have sunshine continue to reach the windows of her building.
choices.D: Grant the architect the requested injunction.

questions.explanation:
Remedies for nuisance & easement actions

Temporary nuisance Permanent nuisance Misuse / interference of easement
Damages
  • Diminished rental value
  • Reasonable repair costs
  • Incidental loss
  • Loss of use & enjoyment
  • Punitive damages
  • Diminished land value
  • Rents received
  • Decreased value of servient estate and/or easement
  • Value of excessive use
  • Cost of restoration
  • Loss of use
Injunction Available N/A Available
Self-help Available N/A Available
Forfeiture N/A Unavailable unless injunction will not relieve servient estate

The Doctrine of Ancient Lights, which originated in England and provides that a landowner acquires an easement for light and air after 20 years of uninterrupted access, has been rejected in the United States. Blockage of light is generally not a public or private nuisance unless motivated by malice. A right to light exists only if it is protected by statute or by an express negative easement.

Applied to these facts, the court should grant judgment for the developer because the architect has no legal right to light. (Choices A & D)

(Choice B) Governmental approvals do not bar others from exercising their legal rights, but because no right to light exists here, this fact is irrelevant.

📌 Educational Objective

A landowner only has a right to light if (1) this right is protected by statute or (2) the landowner enters into an express agreement with the other landowner to create a negative easement or covenant.

📚 References
  • Mohr v. Midas Realty Corp., 431 N.W.2d 380, 382 (Iowa 1988)
  • Sher v. Leiderman, 226 Cal. Rptr. 698, 701 (Ct. App. 1986)
questions.zh-question:
一位建筑师和一位开发商拥有相邻的地块。在他们各自的地块上，都有一座低层办公楼。这两座办公楼高度相同。

去年，开发商决定拆除其地块上的低层办公楼，并根据分区和建筑条例的许可，在其地块上建造一座高度显著增加的新高层办公楼。她获得了推进其项目所需的所有政府批准。

当开发商的新建筑正在施工时，建筑师意识到其产生的阴影将使她的建筑处于极深的阴影中，从而导致她可以收取的建筑空间租金大幅下降。

建筑师对开发商提起了适当的诉讼，要求禁止施工以消除阴影问题，并要求损害赔偿。建筑师出示了无可争议的证据，证明她对阴影影响其建筑公平租赁价值的评估是正确的。除了建筑和分区条例之外，没有其他法规或条例适用于法院审理的这些问题。

法院应如何裁决？

zh-choices.A: 判给建筑师以租金价值损失计算的损害赔偿，但不发布禁令。
zh-choices.B: 作出对开发商有利的判决，因为她已获得新建筑所需的所有政府批准。
zh-choices.C: 作出对开发商有利的判决，因为建筑师没有法律权利要求阳光持续照射到其建筑的窗户。
zh-choices.D: 准予建筑师所请求的禁令。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Rights in Real Property - Nuisance

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：邻地高楼遮光能不能被当成可诉的 nuisance，以及原告是否真有“继续见到阳光”的权利。

三秒认题路径：

遮光 → nuisance → 有无权利 → 看例外 → 选 C

核心法律规则

一眼能用的规则

Doctrine of Ancient Lights（古老采光规则）在美国已经被拒绝，考场意思：邻居家不会因为你一直有阳光，就自动长出一个“必须留光”的权利。

一般来说，遮挡光线不构成 nuisance（妨害），除非是恶意阻挡，或者有成文法、express negative easement（明示消极地役权） 这类特别来源。

所以这题不看开发商有没有拿齐审批，而是看建筑师有没有法律上的采光权；没有这个权利，就不能靠妨害或禁令把对方拦下。

核心判例： Mohr v. Midas Realty Corp.、Sher v. Leiderman —— 说明美国通常不承认单纯遮光可诉，除非恶意或另有法定/契约基础。

思维导图

先问：原告有“继续见光”的权利吗？
NO：美国不承认 Ancient Lights → 单纯遮光通常不是可诉 nuisance。
卡死点：没有权利，就谈不上靠禁令阻止合法高楼。
再问：有没有例外把权利补出来？
只看两条：statute（成文法） 或 express negative easement（明示消极地役权）。
本题：都没有，所以开发商赢，选 C。
审批通过能不能救原告？
不能。政府批准只是“你能不能建”，不是“你有没有义务给别人留阳光”。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：既然开发商已经拿到所有审批，还会让邻居家变暗，法院是不是应该帮忙救一下。

但考试真正问的是：原告有没有一个能被法律承认的采光权；没有权利，nuisance、禁令和损害赔偿都起不来。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 C？

题干的 shadows 只说明采光变差，不说明原告有权要求保留阳光；美国一般不承认这种自动采光权，所以开发商胜。

❌ 法律适用 | 救济类型误判

✕ A: 把 loss of rental value 当成可赔前提，但先得有可诉权利。

❌ 事实误判 | 审批效力偷换

✕ B: 把 governmental approvals 误当成挡住邻居主张的盾牌。

❌ 概念混淆 | 采光权误认

✕ D: 以为一遮光就能当然发 injunction，但美国没有这种普通采光权。

这题建议用什么方法？

先找“原告有没有这项权利”，再决定能不能把遮光说成妨害或请求禁令。

考场速记

记住一句：light 不是天然权利，先看 statute 或 express negative easement，没有就直接排除。

这题的速记就是：先问“有没有权利”，再问“能不能救济”。

reason.en: Establishes the neighbor relationship in which shadow interference is alleged.
reason.zh: 确立主张阴影干扰所涉及的相邻土地关系。

reason.en: The alleged harm is blocked sunlight, not a conventional nuisance like noise or odor.
reason.zh: 所称损害是阳光被遮挡，而非噪音或气味等传统妨害。

reason.en: Shows substantial economic harm, but economic loss alone does not create a right to light.
reason.zh: 表明存在重大经济损失，但仅有经济损失并不产生采光权。

reason.en: Tests whether any remedy is available once no legal right to light exists.
reason.zh: 检验在不存在合法采光权时是否仍有任何救济。

reason.en: Permits do not create or defeat a neighbor's private rights to light and air.
reason.zh: 许可本身并不创设或剥夺邻人的私法采光通风权。

reason.en: Confirms no statute protects a right to light, leaving only express easement as a source.
reason.zh: 确认无法律保护采光权，权利来源仅剩明示地役权。

reason.en: Assumes liability exists and only limits the remedy to damages.
reason.zh: 预设已成立责任，仅限制救济方式为损害赔偿。

reason.en: Distracts by debating remedy form when no underlying right exists.
reason.zh: 在根本不存在权利时，用救济形式之争误导考生。

B.text: secured all the necessary governmental approvals

reason.en: Attracts test-takers who wrongly treat regulatory approval as a complete defense.
reason.zh: 吸引误将监管许可视为完整抗辩的考生。

C.text: no legal right to have sunshine

reason.en: States the controlling U.S. rule rejecting ancient lights and unprotected shadow claims.
reason.zh: 阐明美国法拒绝古代采光原则、阴影本身不受保护的控制性规则。

reason.en: Identifies the specific interest claimed, which is not protected absent statute or easement.
reason.zh: 点明所主张的具体利益，在无制定法或地役权时不受保护。

reason.en: Treats substantial shadow harm as a private nuisance warranting injunctive relief.
reason.zh: 将重大阴影损害当作可获禁令的私人妨害。

highlights.text: shadows it would create would place the architect's building in such deep shade

reason.en: Defines the interference as loss of sunlight, triggering the no-right-to-light analysis.
reason.zh: 将干扰界定为阳光损失，从而触发无采光权分析。

highlights.text: There is no statute or ordinance (other than the building and zoning ordinances) that is applicable to the issues before the court.

reason.en: Eliminates statutory protection as a basis for relief.
reason.zh: 排除以制定法作为救济依据的可能。

highlights.text: enjoin the construction in order to eliminate the shadow problem and for damages

reason.en: Frames the dispute as a nuisance-style action seeking both injunction and damages.
reason.zh: 将争议框定为寻求禁令与损害赔偿的妨害类请求。

highlights.text: uncontroverted evidence that her evaluation as to the impact of the shadow on the fair rental value of her building was correct

reason.en: Shows proven rental loss still fails because harm without a protected right is insufficient.
reason.zh: 表明即使租金损失已证实，缺乏受保护权利仍不足以胜诉。

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
A landowner orally gave his neighbor permission to share the use of a private road on the landowner's land so that the neighbor could have more convenient access to the neighbor's land. Only the landowner maintained the road. After the neighbor had used the road on a daily basis for three years, the landowner conveyed his land to a grantee, who immediately notified the neighbor that the neighbor was not to use the road. The neighbor sued the grantee, seeking a declaration that the neighbor had a right to continue to use the road.
Who is likely to prevail?

choices.A: The grantee, because an oral license is invalid.
choices.B: The grantee, because the neighbor had a license that the grantee could terminate at any time.
choices.C: The neighbor, because the grantee is estopped from terminating the neighbor's use of the road.
choices.D: The neighbor, because the neighbor's use of the road was open and notorious when the grantee purchased the land.

questions.explanation:
Licenses, easements & profits
License Revocable privilege to enter & use another's land for specific purpose
Easement Nonpossessory interest in land that gives easement holder right to:
  • use another's land for specific purpose (ie, affirmative easement) or
  • prohibit other owner from doing something on land that owner would otherwise be allowed to do (ie, negative easement)
Profit Nonpossessory interest in land that gives profit holder right to enter another's land to remove products of soil (eg, timber, minerals, oil)

A license is a grant of permission to enter and use another's land for a specific purpose. Unlike easements, licenses do not create an interest in the land. As a result, they are not subject to the statute of frauds and can be created orally or by another act demonstrating the licensor's intent to let the licensee enter the property (Choice A). Licenses can generally be revoked at any time and terminate automatically upon (1) the death of either party or (2) conveyance of the licensed property.

Here, the landowner orally gave his neighbor permission to use a private road on his land. This created a license, which terminated automatically when the landowner conveyed his land to the grantee. Additionally, the grantee's immediately notifying the neighbor to stop using the road demonstrates that the grantee did not intend to revive the license. As a result, the neighbor has no right to continue to use the road, and the grantee is likely to prevail.

(Choice C) A license may become irrevocable, and the licensor may be estopped (ie, precluded) from revoking it, if the licensee expends substantial money, labor, or other resources in reliance on the license. But estoppel does not apply here since the landowner alone maintained the road and there is nothing to suggest that the neighbor expended any resources to use it.

(Choice D) Open and notorious use goes to determining whether a prescriptive easement was acquired. But the neighbor's use of the road was with the landowner's permission, which negates the nonpermissive use required for such an easement.

📌 Educational Objective

A license is a grant of permission to enter and use another's land for a specific purpose. It can be revoked at any time and terminates automatically upon (1) the death of either party or (2) conveyance of the licensed property.

📚 References
  • Restatement of Property §§ 515, 519 (Am. Law Inst. 1944) (creation and revocation of licenses).
  • Rau v. Collins, 891 A.2d 1175, 1184 (Md. App. 2006) (stating that a license terminates automatically upon sale of the licensed property).
questions.zh-question:
一位土地所有者口头允许其邻居共享使用其土地上的一条私人道路，以便邻居可以更方便地进入其邻居的土地。只有该土地所有者维护这条道路。邻居每天使用该道路三年后，土地所有者将其土地转让给了一位受让人。受让人立即通知邻居不得再使用该道路。邻居起诉了受让人，请求法院宣告其有权继续使用该道路。

谁可能胜诉？

zh-choices.A: 受让人，因为口头许可是无效的。
zh-choices.B: 受让人，因为邻居拥有的许可，受让人可以随时终止。
zh-choices.C: 邻居，因为根据禁止反言原则，受让人不得终止邻居对道路的使用。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Rights in Real Property - Easements

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：口头给邻居用私路，只形成许可（license），不是地役权，所以房子一卖，许可通常自动消失，买受人可以立刻赶人。

三秒认题路径：

口头同意 → 私路使用 → 不是地役权 → 房屋转让 → 许可终止

核心法律规则

许可（license）就是“准你进去用一下”的revocable privilege，考场意思：它不给你土地上的权利，只给你一个可撤回的进出权限。地役权（easement）才是土地上的非占有性利益，考场意思：它像跟地块绑定的使用权，通常不会因为一句“我不让你用了”就消失。

许可一般可以随时撤回，而且在受许可财产（licensed property）转让时会自动终止；所以原土地所有人把地卖给新买受人后，邻居的许可就没了。这里没有书面设立、也没有可救济的依赖投入，因此不能把它抬成可永久对抗买受人的权益。

核心判例： Rau v. Collins - 许可在许可土地被出售时通常自动终止，买受人可拒绝继续让其使用。

思维导图

先看：邻居到底拿到的是不是地役权（easement）？
事实1口头同意 + 只是方便通行 → 更像许可（license），不是土地利益。
事实2只是邻居使用私路，土地仍由房主维护 → 没有依赖性投入，没法直接变成不可撤销许可。
再看：土地一转让，许可还能跟着新地主继续吗？
规则许可通常在转让时自动终止；买受人收到后立即通知停止使用，等于把“继续使用”的门关上。
卡死点：没有地役权，只有可撤销许可；一转让就终止，答案走向 B。
错觉“用了三年”不等于权利升级；开放、明显只会让人想到prescriptive easement，但这里有许可，直接掐掉非许可使用要件。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：邻居用了三年、还很方便，看起来像已经“占住了”一条通路。
但考试真正问的是：他有没有拿到能对抗新买受人的地役权（easement）；答案没有，因为一开始就是许可。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，不是「物理上的道路看起来有没有一直在用」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 B？

题干的oral permission只形成许可；房主一转让土地，许可就自动终止，新地主立即通知停止使用，所以邻居不能继续用路。

❌ 概念混淆 | 书面要件误判

✕ A: 把“口头”当成无效，其实许可本来就能口头成立。

❌ 法律适用 | 依赖投入误判

✕ C: 想用estopped锁死许可，但题干没有邻居投入钱或劳动。

❌ 事实误判 | 非许可使用误判

✕ D: 把“open and notorious”套成既得权，但这里是有许可的使用，不是敌意占用。

这题建议用什么方法？

先认是许可还是地役权，再看有没有转让终止和依赖性例外。

考场速记

记住一句：“许可可撤，地役权随地，许可一卖常终止。” 看到口头同意进路、又出现土地转让，先默认是许可，不要急着往地役权、时效地役权或 estoppel 上跳。

question_analysis.skill_tested: Distinguish revocable license from easement

reason.en: Oral permission creates a license, not an easement subject to the statute of frauds.
reason.zh: 口头准许构成许可，而非须遵守欺诈法 Statute of Frauds 的地役权。

reason.en: Defines the limited purpose for which entry onto the servient land was allowed.
reason.zh: 界定被允许进入他人土地的具体用途范围。

keywords.text: Only the landowner maintained the road

reason.en: Shows the neighbor did not rely by spending money or labor, defeating estoppel.
reason.zh: 表明邻居未因信赖而支出金钱或劳务，排除禁止反言。

reason.en: Extended use was with permission, so it does not ripen into a prescriptive easement.
reason.zh: 长期使用系经许可进行，不能形成时效地役权。

keywords.text: conveyed his land to a grantee

reason.en: A license automatically terminates when the licensed property is conveyed.
reason.zh: 许可土地转让时，许可自动终止。

keywords.text: a right to continue to use the road

reason.en: The neighbor seeks an ongoing property-like right rather than a mere revocable privilege.
reason.zh: 邻居主张的是持续性的财产性权利，而非可随时撤销的特权。

reason.en: Licenses are not subject to the statute of frauds and may be created orally.
reason.zh: 许可不受欺诈法规制，可以口头设立。

reason.en: Correctly identifies the neighbor's interest as a nonpossessory, revocable permission.
reason.zh: 正确将邻居的利益定性为无占有权、可撤销的准许。

reason.en: States the governing rule that ended the neighbor's right upon conveyance and notice.
reason.zh: 说明转让及通知后邻居权利终止的适用规则。

reason.en: Estoppel requires substantial reliance expenditure, which is absent here.
reason.zh: 禁止反言须以重大信赖支出为前提，本案不存在。

reason.en: Open and notorious use alone does not create an easement when use was permissive.
reason.zh: 公然使用本身不足以在经许可使用时成立地役权。

highlights.text: orally gave his neighbor permission

reason.en: Triggers license analysis instead of an easement or covenant in writing.
reason.zh: 触发许可规则分析，而非书面地役权或契约。

highlights.text: Only the landowner maintained the road

reason.en: Negates irrevocable-license estoppel based on money, labor, or resources spent.
reason.zh: 排除邻居因金钱、劳务或其他资源投入而产生的不可撤销许可。

highlights.text: conveyed his land to a grantee

reason.en: Conveyance of the servient estate ends the prior license by operation of law.
reason.zh: 供役地转让依法终止原有许可。

highlights.text: used the road on a daily basis for three years

reason.en: Length and openness do not convert permitted use into a prescriptive easement.
reason.zh: 使用时间长且公开，并不能将经许可使用转化为时效地役权。

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
A woman acquired land by a deed that contained the following language in the grantee section: "to [the woman], her heirs and assigns, provided, however, that said grantee may not transfer any interest in the land for 10 years from the date of this instrument."
Two years later, the woman contracted to sell the land to an investor for a price based on a recent appraisal. When the investor's title search revealed the above language in the grantee section of the deed to the woman, the investor refused to close the transaction. The contract was silent as to the woman's title obligation.
The woman has sued the investor for specific performance.
Who is likely to prevail?

choices.A: The investor, because the woman cannot sell the land during the 10-year period specified in the deed.
choices.B: The investor, because the woman's heirs did not join in the contract.
choices.C: The woman, because the contract did not obligate her to provide marketable title.
choices.D: The woman, because the deed's restraint on transfer is void as a matter of law.

questions.explanation:
Restraints on alienation

(restrictions on transferability of real property)

Validity Examples
Direct
(disfavored)
  • Only valid if reasonable
  • Balance utility of restraint against harm resulting from enforcement
  • Prohibiting some or all types of transfers
  • Prohibiting transfer without consent
  • Prohibiting transfer to particular persons
Indirect Valid unless lacking rational justification
  • Imposing transfer fees
  • Limiting property's use/reducing its value

A restraint on alienation is a restriction on the transferability of an interest in property. Direct restraints are disfavored and are valid only if they are deemed reasonable. Courts balance the utility of the restraint against the harm resulting from its enforcement. A total restraint on the alienation of a fee simple estate is always unreasonable and void.

A woman executed a deed conveying a fee simple estate that included a provision prohibiting any transfer of the property for 10 years. This provision constitutes a direct restraint on alienation and, because it prohibits all transfers for a specified period, it is a total restraint on a fee simple estate. The deed's words of limitation—"and her heirs"—indicate a fee simple estate. Because the restraint is a total restraint on a fee simple estate, it is void as a matter of law. Thus, the woman can sell the land, and the investor cannot avoid the contract on this basis (Choice A).

(Choice B) The phrase "and her heirs" in the deed conveys a fee simple estate but does not give the heirs an ownership interest in the property. Therefore, the woman's heirs did not need to join in the contract.

(Choice C) Every contract for the sale of land contains an implied obligation to deliver marketable title at closing. It does not matter that the contract did not expressly state this obligation.

📌 Educational Objective

Direct restraints on alienation (eg, prohibitions on some or all types of transfers) are valid only if they are deemed reasonable. Total restraints on the alienability of fee simple estates are always unreasonable.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Third) of Property: Servitudes § 3.4 (Am. Law Inst. 2000) (direct restraints on alienation).
questions.zh-question:
一名女子通过一份契约获得了一块土地，契约的受让人部分包含以下语言：“授予[该女子]、其继承人和受让人，但前提是，所述受让人自本文件签订之日起10年内不得转让该土地的任何权益。”

两年后，该女子签订合同，以近期评估价为基础将该土地出售给一名投资者。当投资者的产权调查发现授予该女子的契约受让人部分存在上述语言时，投资者拒绝完成交易。合同对该女子的产权义务未作规定。

该女子已起诉投资者，要求其强制履行合同。

谁可能胜诉？

zh-choices.A: 投资者，因为该女子在契约规定的10年期限内不能出售该土地。
zh-choices.B: 投资者，因为该女子的继承人没有加入合同。
zh-choices.C: 该女子，因为合同没有规定她必须提供可售卖产权。
zh-choices.D: 该女子，因为契约中的转让限制在法律上是无效的。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Rights in Real Property - Restraints On Alienation

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：费简单绝对（fee simple absolute）上的直接转让限制（direct restraint on alienation）是不是有效；答案是通常无效，所以买方不能靠这句话直接毁约。

三秒认题路径：

10年不得转让 → 直接限制 → fee simple → 全面禁止 → 直接无效

核心法律规则

一眼能用的规则

限制转让（restraint on alienation）就是限制土地能不能卖、能不能转。直接限制（direct restraint）很少被允许，考场意思：法院要看它是不是reasonable，但如果它把fee simple的转让完全卡死，通常就是无效。

这里写的是“10年内不得转让任何权益”，这不是轻微限制，而是对fee simple的total restraint。考场上看到这种条款，直接结论就是：条款作废，卖方仍可转让。

核心判例： Restatement (Third) of Property: Servitudes § 3.4 — 直接限制若是不合理就无效，而对 fee simple 的全面禁转通常一律无效。

思维导图

先看这是不是 直接限制（direct restraint）？
是：“10年内不得转让任何权益” = 直接卡住转让。
再看限制对象是不是 fee simple？
是：遗嘱式用语“to [the woman], her heirs and assigns” = 费简单。
卡死点：total restraint on fee simple → 直接无效
结论：限制条款作废 → 女方能卖 → 买方不能拿这句话拒绝履行。
买方想用什么借口逃单？
错误直觉：“合同里看到禁转条款，所以不能成交。”
但考试真正问的是：这条款本身有没有法律效力，而不是你主观上怕不怕。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：既然契约写着 10 年不能卖，那投资人当然可以拒绝过户。

但考试真正问的是：这条禁转规定本身是不是有效；不是“看起来很像限制”就能生效，司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

这题最容易把“合同里有一句限制”误当成“产权真的被锁住了”，其实先要判断限制条款有没有被法律直接打掉。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 D？

题干的 10年内不得转让任何权益 是对 fee simple 的全面直接限制，属于无效条款，所以女方仍可转让，投资人不能据此拒绝成交。

❌ 事实误判 | 误把禁转当有效

✕ A: 以为 cannot sell 真的还能挡住转让，但这条限制本身先被打掉了。

❌ 概念混淆 | heirs误读

✕ B: 把 her heirs 误当成必须签字的共有权人了。

❌ 法律适用 | marketable title错位

✕ C: 拿 marketable title 说事，但本题先卡的是产权限制效力，不是合同是否明示标题义务。

这题建议用什么方法？

先判限制条款效力，再看买方能否据此拒绝履行，别被“写在契约里”四个字带跑。

考场速记

记住一句：fee simple 上的 total direct restraint，通常直接无效；先问“限制本身活不活”，再问“谁能拒绝过户”。

question_analysis.skill_tested: Recognize void total alienation restraints

reason.en: Signals the grantee received a fee simple estate subject to the restraint.
reason.zh: 表明受让人取得的是附带转让限制的绝对所有权。

keywords.text: may not transfer any interest in the land for 10 years

reason.en: A complete ban on transfers for a fixed period is a total restraint on alienation.
reason.zh: 在特定期限内完全禁止转让构成完全转让限制。

keywords.text: contract was silent as to the woman's title obligation

label.zh: 默示可售产权义务问题

reason.en: Tests whether an implied marketable-title duty still applies despite silence.
reason.zh: 测试合同未写明时是否仍负有默示可售产权义务。

reason.en: The investor's refusal triggers the dispute over title and enforceability.
reason.zh: 投资者拒付引发关于产权与限制可执行性的争议。

reason.en: The remedy sought depends on whether the contract remains enforceable.
reason.zh: 所请求的救济取决于合同是否仍可强制执行。

keywords.text: 10 years from the date of this instrument

reason.en: Shows the restraint is temporal and prohibits all transfers during that window.
reason.zh: 表明该限制具有时间性且在该期间内禁止一切转让。

A.text: cannot sell the land during the 10-year period

reason.en: Treats the deed restriction as enforceable even though a total fee simple restraint is void.
reason.zh: 将契据限制视为可执行，但绝对所有权的完全限制依法无效。

reason.en: Focuses on the written prohibition instead of its invalidity on a fee simple estate.
reason.zh: 仅关注书面禁止条款，忽略其在绝对所有权上的无效性。

B.text: heirs did not join in the contract

reason.en: Misreads 'heirs' as present owners rather than words creating a fee simple.
reason.zh: 误将'继承人'理解为现所有权人，而非创设绝对所有权的用语。

C.text: did not obligate her to provide marketable title

reason.en: Ignores the implied obligation to deliver marketable title in land-sale contracts.
reason.zh: 忽略土地买卖合同中默示的可售产权交付义务。

reason.en: Even without an express clause, the seller must convey marketable title at closing.
reason.zh: 即使合同未明示，卖方在交割时仍须提供可售产权。

D.text: restraint on transfer is void as a matter of law

reason.en: States the controlling rule that voids the deed's total restraint on a fee simple.
reason.zh: 陈述使契据中对绝对所有权的完全限制无效的控制性规则。

D.text: void as a matter of law

reason.en: Confirms the restraint fails without a reasonableness balancing inquiry.
reason.zh: 表明该限制无需进行合理性衡量即归于无效。

highlights.text: may not transfer any interest in the land for 10 years from the date of this instrument

reason.en: This language creates the direct total restraint whose validity controls the answer.
reason.zh: 该用语构成直接完全转让限制，其效力决定本题答案。

highlights.text: her heirs and assigns

reason.en: Identifies the estate type to which the total-restraint voidness rule applies.
reason.zh: 确定适用完全限制无效规则的不动产权利类型。

highlights.text: contract was silent as to the woman's title obligation

reason.en: Tests a secondary trap about whether the seller still must deliver marketable title.
reason.zh: 测试卖方是否仍须交付可售产权的次要陷阱。

highlights.text: The woman has sued the investor for specific performance

reason.en: Frames the dispute as whether the sale contract can be enforced despite the deed language.
reason.zh: 将争议框定为契据用语存在时销售合同是否仍可强制执行。

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
Ten years ago, a couple bought a building and moved into its second-floor apartment with their teenage daughter. The couple operated a shoe store on the first floor of the building for many years. When the couple purchased the building, the area was predominantly rural and was zoned for nonresidential use. The municipality's zoning is cumulative.
Five years ago, the municipality rezoned the area to single-family residential use. The daughter was not aware of this change because she was away at college.
Recently, the daughter inherited the building from her parents. The daughter immediately moved into the apartment and took over the operation of the shoe store on the first floor. The daughter has learned that a developer is planning to build a large residential community in the area surrounding her building.
The daughter has asked her lawyer for advice regarding her ability to continue operating the shoe store.
Should the lawyer advise the daughter that she can continue to operate her shoe store?

choices.A: No, because the nonconforming use of the building terminated when the daughter's parents died.
choices.B: No, but the municipality must pay her reasonable compensation for her loss resulting from the change in zoning.
choices.C: Yes, because the shoe store is a nonconforming use.
choices.D: Yes, because the zoning is cumulative and the building is also used for single-family residential purposes.

questions.explanation:
Cumulative zoning
(permits higher use in lower-use zones)
Single-family
Multi-family
Commercial
Light-industrial
Heavy-industrial
High
Low

A nonconforming use arises when property was used in a lawful manner before a zoning law was enacted and that use continues even though it is now prohibited. The owner has a "grandfathered right" to continue the use unless: (1) it is enlarged, changed, or abandoned, or (2) the zoning law provides an amortization period or requires registration which has not been met.

Here, the building was in a nonresidential area when the couple began operating a shoe store. When the area was rezoned to single-family residential, the store became a nonconforming use. Because the store was continuously operated—first by the couple and then by their daughter after they died—she can continue to operate it. (Choice C)

Under the Fifth Amendment takings clause, a municipality must pay compensation when a law takes private property for public use (eg, by depriving the property of all or nearly all of its economic value). However, no compensation is required here because the zoning law does not affect the daughter's ability to continue operating the shoe store. (Choice B)

Zoning is cumulative when it permits a higher use in a lower use zone. Here, the area was rezoned to the "highest" use (residential), so the "lower" commercial use cannot exist in that zone unless it is a nonconforming use. The fact that the building is also used for single-family residential purposes does not change the commercial character of the shoe store. (Choice D)

📌 Educational Objective

A nonconforming use may continue until (1) the owner enlarges, changes, or abandons that use or (2) if provided in the zoning law, an amortization period has passed or the use has not been registered.

📚 References
  • Pa. Nw. Distribs., Inc. v. Zoning Hearing Bd., 584 A.2d 1372, 1375–76 (Pa. 1991) (describing the right to and termination of a nonconforming use).
  • 83 Am. Jur. 2d Zoning & Planning §§ 524–93 (2019).
questions.zh-question:
十年前，一对夫妇买下了一栋楼，并与他们十几岁的女儿一起搬进了二楼的公寓。这对夫妇在该楼的一楼经营鞋店多年。当这对夫妇购买这栋楼时，该地区主要为乡村地区，并被划为非住宅用途区。该市的区划是累积性的。

五年前，该市将该地区重新划为单户住宅用途区。女儿对此变更不知情，因为她当时在外地上大学。

最近，女儿从父母那里继承了这栋楼。女儿立即搬进了公寓，并接管了一楼鞋店的经营。女儿了解到，一位开发商正计划在她的大楼周围地区建造一个大型住宅社区。

女儿向她的律师咨询了关于她是否能继续经营鞋店的建议。

律师是否应该建议女儿她可以继续经营她的鞋店？

zh-choices.A: 不应该，因为当女儿的父母去世时，该建筑的不合规定用途已经终止。
zh-choices.B: 不应该，但市政府必须为她因区划变更而造成的损失支付合理补偿。
zh-choices.C: 应该，因为鞋店是一种不合规定用途。
zh-choices.D: 应该，因为区划是累积性的，并且该建筑也用于单户住宅目的。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Rights in Real Property - Government Regulation of Land--Zoning

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：分区改造后，原本合法的商店是否还能作为不合规使用（nonconforming use）继续存在。

三秒认题路径：

先看原来合法 → 再看后来禁用 → 还在连续用 → 没扩张没放弃 → 可继续经营

核心法律规则

不合规使用（nonconforming use）考场意思：房产在新分区法出台前已经合法使用，后来虽然被新法禁止，但只要没有被扩大、改变或放弃，通常可以继续用。

累积制分区（cumulative zoning）考场意思：允许“更高”用途出现在“更低”用途区里；但本题把地区改成单一家庭住宅区后，商业用途反而成了被压下去的旧用途，不能靠“累积制”自动消失。

所以这题只问一件事：女儿接手后，原来的鞋店有没有变成还能继续的grandfathered right；答案是有，因为经营一直连续。

核心判例： Pa. Nw. Distribs., Inc. v. Zoning Hearing Bd. — 说明不合规使用的继续权和终止条件：没扩大、没放弃、没触发法定淘汰期，就还能继续。

思维导图

原始状态 购入时：非住宅区，卖鞋店合法
→
法规变化 后来改成单一家庭住宅区，商业被禁
→
触发结论 旧商业用途变成 nonconforming use
→
连续使用 父母一直经营，女儿继承后马上接手
→
最终答案 可以继续开鞋店，选 C

考点陷阱

你可能会想：父母死了、女儿继承了，旧的经营权就断了。

但考试真正问的是：有没有扩张、改变或放弃；这里只是换了所有人，店还在连续开。

这题看的是「法律上还能不能继续用」，不是「换了继承人就自动清零」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 C？

题干显示鞋店在分区变更前就已合法经营，且一直连续开到女儿继承后仍在运营，所以它是可继续的nonconforming use。

❌ 事实误判 | 继承即终止

✕ A: 把 parents died 当成终止点了。

❌ 法律适用 | 征收混入

✕ B: 误把分区变更当成 takings clause 征收。

❌ 概念混淆 | 累积制误读

✕ D: 把 cumulative 读成能保住商业用途。

这题建议用什么方法？

先抓“原来合法+后来禁止+持续使用”三连，再排除继承、征收和累积制的假线索。

考场速记

记住一句：不合规使用看的是“先合法、后被禁、还在用”。

口诀：In Certain Circumstances, An Appeal Can Be Made Prematurely 是中间上诉例外的记忆法；但这题不是上诉题，真正要背的是“没扩大、没放弃、通常能续用”。

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
A man conveyed a valid easement appurtenant across his ranch to a woman who owned the adjoining property, on which she operated a commercial farm. The easement was not recorded. Shortly before his death, the man devised his ranch to his son. The will made no mention of the woman's easement. The son, who lived out-of-state, never came to visit the ranch. The woman decided to expand the size of her crops and openly used the man's ranch to do so. She paid the taxes on the property and used the land exclusively for 20 years. However, she never used the easement during that time.
After facing some financial hardship, the son decided to sell the ranch. To prevent the sale, the woman filed and won a quiet-title suit confirming that she had acquired ownership of the ranch through adverse possession. The son felt guilty about losing his father's ranch, so he worked out a deal with the woman to repurchase the ranch.
After the sale, the woman resumed her use of the easement across the ranch that had been granted to her by the man. The son, already angry over having to repurchase the ranch, immediately objected to the woman entering his property. The woman has filed suit to enforce the easement.
The jurisdiction has a notice recording act.
Will the woman likely prevail?

choices.A: No, because she acquired title to the ranch through adverse possession.
choices.B: No, because the son was not provided proper notice of the easement.
choices.C: Yes, because an easement appurtenant automatically runs with the land.
choices.D: Yes, because failure to use an easement does not extinguish it.

questions.explanation:
Easement created by (WIPE):
  • Writing
  • Implication/Necessity
  • Prescription
  • Estoppel
Benefits land or easement holder?
Land
Easement Appurtenant automatically transfers when land is conveyed
Easement holder
Easement in Gross does not transfer when land is conveyed
Terminated by (DAMPER):
  • Destruction of servient estate
  • Abandonment
  • Merger
  • Prescription
  • Estoppel
  • Release (satisfying statute of frauds)

The man granted an easement appurtenant across his ranch. The ranch is the servient estate, and the woman's farm is the dominant estate. This type of easement runs with the land but is subject to recording acts.

The jurisdiction has a notice recording act. The son, who was devised the ranch, is not a "purchaser for value" and thus is not protected by the act. The lack of notice is of no consequence (Choice B).

Under the merger doctrine, an easement will terminate when the dominant estate and servient estate merge into the hands of a single owner. This happened when the woman acquired title to both properties. The easement was extinguished (Choice C).

A terminated easement cannot be revived by resevering the estates; a new one must be created. Since no new easement was created, the woman will not prevail.

*Easements are presumed to be appurtenant unless otherwise stated.

(Choice D) Abandonment requires an affirmative act showing intent to relinquish; "mere nonuse" is insufficient. The easement was terminated by merger instead.

📌 Educational Objective

Under the merger doctrine, an easement terminates once the dominant and servient estates merge into the hands of a single owner.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Third) of Property: Servitudes § 7.5 (Am. Law Inst. 2000) (termination of easement by merger).
questions.zh-question:
一名男子将其牧场上的一项有效从属地役权（easement appurtenant）转让给了一位拥有相邻土地的女性，该女性在其土地上经营一个商业农场。该地役权未被登记。在去世前不久，该男子通过遗嘱将其牧场遗赠给了他的儿子。遗嘱中没有提及该女性的地役权。儿子住在州外，从未前来探访过该牧场。该女性决定扩大其作物种植规模，并为此公开使用了该男子的牧场。她支付了该地产的税款，并独占地使用了该土地长达20年。然而，在此期间她从未使用过该地役权。

在遭遇一些财务困境后，儿子决定出售该牧场。为阻止出售，该女性提起并赢得了一场确认产权诉讼，确认她已通过侵权逆占（adverse possession）获得了该牧场的所有权。儿子对于失去父亲的牧场感到内疚，因此他与该女性达成协议，回购了该牧场。

出售后，该女性恢复使用了由该男子授予她的、穿越该牧场的地役权。儿子本就因不得不回购牧场而感到愤怒，他立即反对该女性进入他的地产。该女性已提起诉讼，要求强制执行该地役权。

该司法管辖区实行登记告知法案（notice recording act）。

该女性是否可能胜诉？

zh-choices.A: 否，因为她通过侵权逆占获得了该牧场的所有权。
zh-choices.B: 否，因为儿子没有得到关于该地役权的适当通知。
zh-choices.C: 是，因为从属地役权自动随土地转移。
zh-choices.D: 是，因为未使用地役权并不会使其消灭。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Rights in Real Property - Easements

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：地役权（easement）虽然本来会随地转移，但一旦供役地和需役地合并到同一人手里，就会因为并入消灭（merger）而终止。

三秒认题路径：

地役权存在 → 两地合一 → 先灭掉 → 不能复活 → 原告败

核心法律规则

附地地役权（easement appurtenant）是跟着土地走的，考场意思：原本会随着需役地转让给新主人。

但如果需役地（dominant estate）和供役地（servient estate）最后落到同一人手里，就会发生并入（merger），考场意思：这条地役权直接死掉，不是暂时停用。

死掉以后，后面再把两块地分开，也不会自动复活；要重新设立一条新的地役权才行。

核心判例： Restatement (Third) of Property: Servitudes § 7.5 — 供役地和需役地并入同一人手里时，地役权终止。

思维导图

先看：这条地役权（easement）还活着吗？
1.原本是附地地役权（easement appurtenant），所以本来会随土地转移。
2.但女人后来拿到整块 ranch 的所有权，需役地 + 供役地 = 同一人。
卡死点：并入（merger）一发生，地役权先终止，后面不能靠“再分开”自动恢复。
再看：后来她再用老地役权，能不能赢？
不能。因为她手里只剩“已经死掉的旧权利”，而不是一条重新设立的新地役权。
答案：选 A，不是因为她没通知到，而是因为她自己先把地役权合并消灭了。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：她已经连续用了很多年，而且还是地役权，应该会自动跟着土地继续存在。

但考试真正问的是：这条权利在她后来把两块地买到自己手里时，已经先被并入（merger）弄死了，之后再分开也不会自动复活。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的通道有没有继续被使用」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 A？

题干关键信息是她后来通过 quiet-title 拿到 ranch 所有权，需役地与供役地合一，所以旧地役权因 merger 已终止，不能再拿来对抗现任主人。

❌ 事实误判 | 通知对象看错

✕ B: 把 proper notice 当成决定点了；本题先死的是地役权本身，不是录音通知问题。

❌ 法律适用 | 自动转移误套

✕ C: 只记得 runs with the land，却漏了 merger 已经把这条权利切断。

❌ 概念混淆 | 非使用当成保留

✕ D: 以为没用过就还在；但真正让它消失的是合并，不是长期不用。

这题建议用什么方法？

先抓权利是否已终止，再看后续转让和使用；别让“本来会随地跑”盖掉 merger 这个卡死点。

考场速记

记住一句：地役权会跟地走，但合一就先死。看到 easement 题，先问“有没有 merger”，再问“有没有重新设立”。

reason.zh: 决定未登记地役权是否约束后续产权人。

A.text: acquired title to the ranch through adverse possession

B.text: not provided proper notice of the easement

C.text: easement appurtenant automatically runs with the land

reason.zh: 一般规则正确，但合并消灭后不再适用。

D.text: failure to use an easement does not extinguish it

highlights.text: acquired ownership of the ranch through adverse possession

reason.en: Single ownership of dominant and servient estates extinguishes the easement.
reason.zh: 主从不动产归于同一人时地役权消灭。

highlights.text: repurchase the ranch

reason.en: Re-splitting ownership cannot revive a terminated easement.
reason.zh: 重新分割产权不能使已终止的地役权复活。

highlights.text: The jurisdiction has a notice recording act.

reason.en: Tests whether unrecorded status blocks enforcement against the son.
reason.zh: 检验未登记是否阻止对儿子强制执行地役权。

highlights.text: she never used the easement during that time

reason.en: Distracts toward abandonment, but merger—not nonuse—controls termination.
reason.zh: 易引向抛弃规则，但消灭原因是合并而非未使用。

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
A landowner granted a sawmill the exclusive right to remove timber from the landowner's property for 10 years in exchange for a quarterly payment based on the size, type, and number of trees removed. Three years later, the sawmill purchased the landowner's property and built a facility for processing timber on the property. Eight years after purchasing the property, the sawmill sold the timbered portion of the land to a buyer, while retaining the portion of the land on which the processing facility was located. The contract made no specific mention of the prior recorded agreement, but the sawmill had come to rely on the supply of timber from the property. Although there are other sources of timber, timber is a necessary raw material for the sawmill. The buyer has refused to permit the sawmill to continue to remove timber from the property purchased by the buyer.
Which of the following is the sawmill's best argument for the continued existence of a profit?

choices.A: The buyer is estopped from denying the existence of the profit due to the sawmill's reliance on the property as its source for timber.
choices.B: The profit exists by implication.
choices.C: The profit was created by written agreement.
choices.D: Timber is necessary for the sawmill to operate.

questions.explanation:
Easements v. Profits
(methods of creation)
<
Easements v. Profits
(methods of creation)
Express grant
or reservation		NecessityExisting prior
use		PrescriptionEstoppel
Easements✓✓✓
Express grant or reservationNecessityExisting prior usePrescriptionEstoppel
Easements✓✓✓✓✓
Profits✓✓✓✓

A profit (ie, profit à prendre) is a nonpossessory right to enter another’s land and remove specific natural resources (eg, oil, game, timber—as seen here). Profits are generally created and analyzed similarly to easements. As a result, a profit can be implied from an existing prior use if the following elements are met:

  • Severance of common ownership – the dominant (benefited) and servient (burdened) estates were once a single tract of land, after which the owner retained part of the tract and conveyed the rest to another
  • Prior existing use – the owner used the servient estate to benefit the dominant estate
  • Apparent and continuous – prior use was discoverable by a reasonable inspection and continued until the tract was severed
  • Reasonable necessity – continuation of the prior use is reasonably necessary for the use and enjoyment of the land

Here, the sawmill owned the entire property before selling the timbered portion to a buyer. The sawmill had been apparently and continuously removing timber from the land until the sale. And the continued removal of timber is reasonably necessary since the sawmill has come to rely on the supply of timber from the buyer’s land to operate. Therefore, the sawmill’s best argument is that the profit exists by implication.

(Choice A) A profit can be created by estoppel if the profit holder, in good faith, reasonably and detrimentally relies on permission from the owner of the land that serves as the source of the profit (not seen here).

(Choice B) Although the original landowner granted the sawmill a profit by written agreement (ie, an express profit), the profit terminated by merger when the sawmill acquired the property to which the profit was tied.

(Choice D) Profits are usually analyzed in the same manner as easements, but profits cannot be created by necessity. Additionally, the availability of other sources of timber would prevent the sawmill from establishing the strict necessity required to create an easement by necessity.

📌 Educational Objective

Profits are generally created and analyzed like easements, so a profit can be implied from an existing prior use.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Third) of Property: Servitudes §167, 1.2(e), cmt. e (Am. Law Inst. 2000) (easement and profit defined).
  • Restatement (Third) of Property: Servitudes §167, 2.12 (Am. Law Inst. 2000) (servitudes implied from prior use).

一位土地所有者授予一家锯木厂从其土地上采伐木材的独家权利，为期10年，以换取根据采伐树木的大小、种类和数量支付的季度款项。三年后，该锯木厂购买了该土地所有者的地产，并在该地产上建造了一个木材加工设施。购买该地产八年后，锯木厂将土地上的林木部分出售给一位买方，同时保留了加工设施所在的土地部分。合同没有具体提及先前的已记录协议，但锯木厂已开始依赖该地产的木材供应。尽管有其他木材来源，但木材是锯木厂必需的原材料。买方拒绝允许锯木厂继续从其购买的土地上采伐木材。

以下哪项是锯木厂主张采益权（profit）继续存在的最佳论据？

zh-choices.A: 由于锯木厂信赖该地产作为其木材来源，买方因禁反言而不得否认该采益权的存在。
zh-choices.B: 该采益权通过默示方式存在。
zh-choices.C: 该采益权是通过书面协议创设的。
zh-choices.D: 木材对于锯木厂的运营是必要的。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Rights in Real Property - Easements

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：利润取用权（profit à prendre）能不能因先前持续使用而默示成立（implied from prior use）。

三秒认题路径：

先前同一地块 → 持续采伐 → 合理必要 → 默示成立 → 选 B

核心法律规则

利润取用权（profit à prendre）是进入他人土地并取走特定自然资源的非占有性权利，像这里的 timber。考场上它通常按地役权（servitude）那套方法来分析，所以也可能从既有先前使用（existing prior use）默示出来。

要默示成立，题干要同时给你：同一地块曾经统一所有、之后发生分割；分割前已经有可见且持续的采伐；而且这种继续采伐对土地使用是reasonably necessary。所以这里不是问“有没有写进合同”，而是问“原来那种一直在做的用法，分家后还能不能继续”。

核心判例： Restatement (Third) of Property: Servitudes § 2.12 — 先前使用满足持续、可见、合理必要时，利润取用权也可默示成立。

思维导图

先看：这是不是在问“能否立即上诉”？
不是。 这题在问 利润取用权（profit） 的来源。
再抓事实：原来同一块地？
是。 先前整块地同属一人，后来才分割出售。
关键关卡：先前使用是否连续、可见、且合理必要？
是。 一直在采伐 timber，且工厂已依赖这块地的供给。
别被“还有别的木材来源”带跑：本题要的是先前使用下的合理必要，不是严格必要；也不是只看书面写没写。
结论：profit exists by implication → 选 B

考点陷阱

你可能会想：既然买卖合同没特别写这个权利，那就只能看书面明示条款。
但考试真正问的是：原来一直在用的采伐方式，分割后能不能按 existing prior use 继续默示下来。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。（本题对应的是权利来源，不是表面上有没有写出来。）

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 B？

题干 同一地块先统一所有、后分割出售，且采伐一直持续并对工厂经营有支撑，所以 profit 可因先前使用而默示成立。

❌ 概念混淆 | 规则渊源误判

✕ A: 把 estopped 当成通用兜底，但题干没给可依赖的许可来源。

❌ 法律适用 | 明示权利误判

✕ C: 盯着 written agreement，却漏了原权利后来因合并已消灭。

❌ 事实误判 | 必要程度偷换

✕ D: 把 necessary 误当严格必要；这里还有别的木材来源。

这题建议用什么方法？

先找权利类型，再看是否有先前使用的四个信号：统一所有、先前使用、可见持续、合理必要。

考场速记

记住一句：profit 和地役权一起看，先前使用能默示，关键不是“写没写”，而是“原来一直怎么用、分割后还能不能接着用”。

question_analysis.skill_tested: Apply merger and implied profit rules

reason.en: Identifies the original interest as a profit rather than a mere license or contract right.
reason.zh: 表明原始权利属于取用权，而非单纯许可或合同权利。

reason.en: When the profit holder acquired the fee, merger likely extinguished the original profit.
reason.zh: 取用权人取得土地所有权时，原取用权可能因合并而消灭。

keywords.text: sold the timbered portion of the land to a buyer

keywords.text: retaining the portion of the land on which the processing facility was located

reason.en: The retained processing land may need continued timber access from the sold parcel.
reason.zh: 保留的加工用地可能需要继续从已售地块取得木材。

keywords.text: made no specific mention of the prior recorded agreement

label.zh: 契据未提及既有取用权

reason.en: Shows the buyer was not expressly bound by the earlier recorded profit.
reason.zh: 说明买方未被契据明确绑定于先前登记的取用权。

keywords.text: rely on the supply of timber from the property

reason.en: Supports implication but alone does not establish estoppel or necessity as the best theory.
reason.zh: 支持默示主张，但单凭依赖不足以构成最佳禁反言或必要通行理论。

reason.en: Frames the original grant as a limited profit, not fee ownership of timber.
reason.zh: 表明最初授予的是有期限的取用权，而非永久木材所有权。

A.text: estopped from denying the existence of the profit

reason.en: Reliance is tempting but is weaker than implication from the severance of ownership.
reason.zh: 依赖虽具吸引力，但弱于因分割所有权而产生的默示取用权主张。

A.text: reliance on the property as its source for timber

reason.en: Misdirects toward estoppel instead of the implied profit created by the conveyance structure.
reason.zh: 将考生引向禁反言，而非因转让结构产生的默示取用权。

reason.en: Best theory when a grantor sells servient land but retains land that needs the profit.
reason.zh: 当出让人出售供役地但保留需继续享有用益的地块时，此为最佳理论。

label.zh: 先前书面授予的取用权

reason.en: The original writing likely merged and does not automatically bind the buyer after severance.
reason.zh: 原书面协议可能已因合并而消灭，分割后不会自动约束买方。

D.text: Timber is necessary for the sawmill to operate

reason.en: Necessity of timber does not by itself recreate a profit after the land was sold.
reason.zh: 木材经营必要性本身不能在土地出售后重新创设取用权。

highlights.text: purchased the landowner's property

reason.en: Explains why the original recorded profit likely ceased while the sawmill owned the whole tract.
reason.zh: 说明锯木厂拥有整块土地期间，原登记取用权可能已消灭。

highlights.text: sold the timbered portion of the land to a buyer, while retaining the portion of the land on which the processing facility was located

label.zh: 分割转让并保留使用地块

reason.en: This conveyance pattern is the core basis for arguing an implied profit continues.
reason.zh: 这种转让结构是主张默示取用权继续存在的核心依据。

highlights.text: made no specific mention of the prior recorded agreement

reason.en: Defeats choice C and shifts analysis to whether a profit should be implied.
reason.zh: 排除选项C，并将分析转向是否应默示创设取用权。

reason.zh: 界定整个交易过程中争议的不动产权利类型。

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
Six years ago, a landlord and a tenant entered into a 10-year commercial lease of land. The written lease provided that if a public entity under the power of eminent domain condemned any part of the land but not all of it, the lease would terminate and the landlord would receive the entire condemnation award. Thereafter, the city condemned approximately two-thirds of the land.
The tenant notified the city and the landlord that an independent appraisal of the value of the tenant's possessory interest established that it substantially exceeded the tenant's obligation under the lease and that the tenant was entitled to share the award. The appraisal was accurate.
In an appropriate action among the landlord, the tenant, and the city as to the right of the tenant to a portion of the condemnation award, for whom will the court likely find?

choices.A: The landlord, because the condemnation superseded and canceled the lease.
choices.B: The landlord, because the parties specifically agreed as to the consequences of a partial condemnation.
choices.C: The tenant, because otherwise the landlord would be unjustly enriched.
choices.D: The tenant, because the landlord breached the landlord's implied warranty of quiet enjoyment.

questions.explanation:
Taking of leased property by eminent domain
Taking of all leased property for entire lease term
Yes No
Lease terminates
Tenant entitled to:
  • stop paying rent
  • share of condemnation award (fair market value + compensatory damages)
Taking significantly interferes with contemplated use
Yes No
Lease terminates
Tenant entitled to:
  • stop paying rent
  • share of condemnation award (fair market value + compensatory damages)
Lease continues
Tenant entitled to:
  • abate rent
  • share of condemnation award (fair market value + compensatory damages)

A taking of all or part of a leasehold under the power of eminent domain generally entitles the tenant to a share of the condemnation award. The tenant's share of the award is equal to the fair market value of the condemned leasehold plus any amount necessary to compensate the tenant for any continued obligation to pay rent that may be required under the lease.

However, the parties can expressly agree to alternative provisions in the lease, and courts will typically enforce those agreed-upon provisions. Here, the parties specifically agreed that a partial condemnation would terminate the lease and that the landlord would receive the entire condemnation award. Since the lease controls, the tenant is not entitled to any portion of the condemnation award.

(Choice A) The condemnation would have canceled the lease had the city condemned all the land for the entire lease term. Since the city condemned only two-thirds of the land, the lease was terminated in accordance with the landlord and tenant's lease agreement.

(Choice C) Although the landlord may be enriched by the condemnation award, it is not unjust because the parties agreed to the lease provision.

(Choice D) A landlord's implied warranty of quiet enjoyment provides that the tenant's possession and enjoyment of the leased premises will not be disturbed by the landlord or someone with superior title. The taking of leased land under the power of eminent domain does not breach this warranty because the condemnation occurred through no fault of the landlord.

📌 Educational Objective

Unless otherwise provided under a lease, a taking of all or part of a leasehold under the power of eminent domain entitles the tenant to a share of the condemnation award. The tenant's share is equal to the fair market value of the condemned leasehold plus compensation for any continued obligation to pay rent.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Second) of Property: Landlord and Tenant §§ 8.1–8.2 (Am. Law Inst. 1977).
questions.zh-question:
六年前，一位出租人与一位承租人签订了一份为期10年的土地商业租赁合同。书面租约规定，如果公共实体根据 eminent domain (征用权) 征用土地的任何一部分而非全部，租约将终止，并且出租人将获得全部征用补偿金。此后，该市征用了大约三分之二的土地。

承租人通知市政府和出租人，一项对其占有权益价值的独立评估表明，其价值大大超过了租约规定的承租人义务，因此承租人有权分享该补偿金。该评估是准确的。

在出租人、承租人和市政府之间就承租人是否有权获得一部分征用补偿金而提起的适当诉讼中，法院可能会支持哪一方？

zh-choices.A: 出租人，因为征用取代并取消了租约。
zh-choices.B: 出租人，因为双方已就部分征用的后果作出了明确约定。
zh-choices.C: 承租人，因为否则出租人将构成不当得利。
zh-choices.D: 承租人，因为出租人违反了其默示的安宁管有保证。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Rights in Real Property - Condemnation

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：征收（condemnation） 发生后，租约里已经写明“部分征收就终止、补偿金归房东”时，租客还能不能分征收款。

三秒认题路径：

部分征收 → 先看租约 → 有明确约定 → 约定优先 → 房东拿全款

核心法律规则

考场上直接用的规则

征收（condemnation） 只要拿走租赁地的一部分，通常会让承租人有权分到一部分征收补偿；但租约（lease） 可以事先把后果写死，考试上这时先看合同怎么分配，不先猜公平不公平。

如果双方明确约定“部分征收就终止租约，而且征收款全归房东”，法院一般会照这个写法走，所以租客不能再主张自己要分一份。

核心判例： Restatement (Second) of Property: Landlord and Tenant §§ 8.1–8.2 —— 先给一般规则，但也明确承认当事人可以用租约改写部分征收后的分配结果。

思维导图

房东 租约起草人
→
租约条款 部分征收就终止，补偿全归房东
→
城市征收约三分之二 触发一般征收规则
→
租客主张分配补偿 想靠一般规则拿钱
→
结果：按约定走 租客不能分征收款

考点陷阱

你可能会想：既然征收（condemnation） 让租客的占有利益变少了，那租客就该按一般规则直接拿补偿。

但考试真正问的是：当事人已经在租约里把“部分征收后的后果”写清楚时，法院先执行约定，不先替你改成更公平的分法。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 B？

题干的书面租约已明确规定“部分征收就终止且补偿全归房东”，所以租客不能再按一般规则分征收款。

❌ 概念混淆 | 一般规则误判

✕ A: 把一般征收规则直接套上来，忽略了租约已经改写结果。

❌ 事实误判 | 不当公平联想

✕ C: 看到房东得利就想用unjustly enriched 反打，但双方早就约好分配方式。

❌ 法律适用 | 错抓违约点

✕ D: 把征收当成房东违反quiet enjoyment，但这不是房东自己造成的干扰。

这题建议用什么方法？

先抓租约有没有把征收后果写死；有明确约定时，先按约定排除一般补偿规则。

考场速记

记住一句话：征收（condemnation） 的默认分配规则，输给租约里的明确条款。

看到“部分征收 + 明写补偿归谁”时，先别谈公平，先看合同。

question_analysis.skill_tested: Enforce contractual condemnation allocation provisions

reason.en: Triggers condemnation rules governing lease termination and award sharing.
reason.zh: 触发决定租约终止与补偿分配规则的征收制度。

keywords.text: condemned any part of the land but not all of it

reason.en: Partial condemnation activates the lease's special termination and award-allocation clause.
reason.zh: 部分征收激活租约中特殊的终止与补偿分配条款。

reason.en: The agreed partial-taking clause terminates the lease rather than leaving it in force.
reason.zh: 约定的部分征收条款使租约终止而非继续有效。

keywords.text: the landlord would receive the entire condemnation award

label.zh: 房东获得全部征收补偿

reason.en: Contractually overrides the default rule that tenants share condemnation awards.
reason.zh: 以合同约定覆盖租户通常应分得征收补偿的默认规则。

keywords.text: condemned approximately two-thirds of the land

reason.en: Confirms a partial taking occurred, so the lease's partial-condemnation provision applies.
reason.zh: 确认发生部分征收，因而适用租约的部分征收条款。

reason.en: Tenant's appraisal value is irrelevant once the lease controls award allocation.
reason.zh: 一旦租约控制补偿分配，租户占有权益的估值不再决定结果。

reason.en: States the tenant's requested relief that the court must reject under the lease.
reason.zh: 表明租户请求的救济，但依租约法院应驳回该主张。

label.zh: 征收自动取消租约理论

reason.en: Misstates partial condemnation as a total taking that automatically supersedes the lease.
reason.zh: 误将部分征收当作完全征收从而自动取代租约。

reason.en: Identifies the enforceable lease provision that controls the award.
reason.zh: 指出可执行的租约条款决定补偿归属。

reason.en: Matches the actual taking and the lease clause the parties drafted for it.
reason.zh: 与实际的征收情形及当事人为此制定的租约条款相符。

reason.en: Invokes equity to bypass the parties' bargained-for allocation of the award.
reason.zh: 试图以衡平法绕过当事人协商确定的补偿分配。

reason.en: Wrongly treats government condemnation as a landlord breach of possession rights.
reason.zh: 错误地将政府征收视为房东违反占有权。

highlights.text: if a public entity under the power of eminent domain condemned any part of the land but not all of it, the lease would terminate and the landlord would receive the entire condemnation award

label.zh: 部分征收租约分配条款

reason.en: This contractual term directly controls termination and who receives the award.
reason.zh: 该合同条款直接决定租约是否终止及补偿归属。

highlights.text: condemned approximately two-thirds of the land

reason.en: Establishes that the partial-condemnation lease provision governs instead of the default tenant-share rule.
reason.zh: 表明适用租约的部分征收条款，而非默认的租户分补偿规则。

highlights.text: the tenant was entitled to share the award

reason.en: Frames the central issue whether default condemnation rights override the lease.
reason.zh: 构成核心争议：默认征收补偿权是否优先于租约约定。

highlights.text: an independent appraisal of the value of the tenant's possessory interest established that it substantially exceeded the tenant's obligation under the lease

label.zh: 租户权益超过租金义务

reason.en: Attracts test-takers toward tenant recovery but does not overcome the lease allocation.
reason.zh: 诱使考生支持租户获偿，但不足以推翻租约分配约定。

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
A developer and a commercial real estate investment group own adjoining lots near a city's downtown. The developer decided to raze the existing building on its lot and erect an office building of greater height. The developer received all governmental approvals required to pursue the project and no statute or ordinance applies (other than those dealing with various approvals for zoning, building, etc.).
When the building was completed, the investment group discovered that the substantial shadow cast by the developer's new building diminished its ability to lease apartments, substantially lowered the rent it could charge, and greatly reduced the apartment complex's overall occupancy rate. Assume that these facts are proved in an appropriate action the investment group instituted against the developer for all and any relief available.
Which of the following is the most appropriate comment concerning this lawsuit?

choices.A: Judgment should be for the developer, because the investment group has no cause of action.
choices.B: The investment group is entitled to a mandatory injunction requiring the developer to restore conditions to those existing with the prior building insofar as the shadow is concerned.
choices.C: The court should award damages for losses suffered to the date of trial and leave open recovery of future damages.
choices.D: The court should award permanent damages, in lieu of an injunction, equal to the present value of all rents lost and loss on rents for the reasonable life of the apartment complex.

questions.explanation:
Available negative easements
Common law Modern view
  • Light
  • Air
  • Support
  • Water access
  • View
  • Solar access
  • Conservation

The Doctrine of Ancient Lights is an English common law doctrine that enabled landowners to prevent their neighbors from constructing buildings or other structures that blocked their access to sunlight. This doctrine has been rejected in every jurisdiction, so landowners can only restrict another's blockage of light—or other lawful use of their own land—through a negative easement (ie, restrictive covenant). This type of easement can only be created by express written agreement.

Here, the developer's new building casts a substantial shadow over the investment group's apartment complex. But the developer received all necessary governmental approvals to pursue its project and there is no applicable statute. Additionally, there is no indication that the investment group obtained a negative easement or covenant from the developer that would prevent it from blocking the sunlight. Therefore, judgment should be for the developer because the investment group has no cause of action.

(Choices B, C & D) Had the investment group obtained a negative easement, it would have been entitled to an injunction and/or damages. Courts consider several factors in determining the appropriate remedy but tend to issue an injunction for breach of a negative easement. That is because the easement holder is denied the benefit of the easement—ie, the ability to restrict another's lawful use of their own land—if only damages are issued.

📌 Educational Objective

A landowner can only restrict another's lawful use of their own land by obtaining a negative easement (ie, restrictive covenant). And negative easements can only be created by express written agreement.

📚 References
  • Mohr v. Midas Realty Corp., 431 N.W.2d 380, 382 (Iowa 1988) (explaining that every state has rejected the Doctrine of Ancient Lights).
questions.zh-question:
一个开发商和一个商业房地产投资集团在市中心附近拥有相邻地块。该开发商决定拆除其地块上的现有建筑，并建造一座更高的办公楼。该开发商获得了项目所需的所有政府批准，并且没有适用的法规或条例（除了那些处理分区、建筑等各种批准的法规或条例）。

当大楼建成后，该投资集团发现，开发商的新建大楼投下的巨大阴影削弱了其出租公寓的能力，大幅降低了其可收取的租金，并大大降低了公寓大楼的整体入住率。假设这些事实在投资集团对开发商提起的、寻求所有及任何可用救济的适当诉讼中得到证实。

关于这起诉讼，以下哪项评论最为恰当？

zh-choices.A: 判决应有利于开发商，因为投资集团没有诉因。
zh-choices.B: 投资集团有权获得强制性禁令，要求开发商就阴影问题将状况恢复到先前建筑存在时的状态。
zh-choices.C: 法院应就截至审判之日所遭受的损失判给损害赔偿，并对未来损害赔偿的追偿持开放态度。
zh-choices.D: 法院应判给永久性损害赔偿，以代替禁令，其金额应等于在公寓大楼的合理使用年限内所有租金损失和租金减损的现值。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Rights in Real Property - Easements

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：邻地建筑挡住光线时，能不能靠 负地役权（negative easement） 或所谓 古老灯火原则（Doctrine of Ancient Lights） 起诉对方。

三秒认题路径：

挡光 → 想告对方 → 先看权利来源 → 没有书面负地役权 → 不能赢

核心法律规则

考场上只抓这一条

古老灯火原则（Doctrine of Ancient Lights） 在美国已经被全部州放弃；所以，土地所有人不能只因为邻居的新建筑 挡住光线（block light） 就当然起诉成功。

想限制别人对自己土地的合法使用，必须先有 负地役权（negative easement），也就是通过 明确书面协议（express written agreement） 先把权利拿到手。没有这个权利，就没有可执行的诉因。

核心判例： Mohr v. Midas Realty Corp. —— 说明所有州都已拒绝 Doctrine of Ancient Lights，挡光本身通常不能单独构成可诉权利。

思维导图

邻楼挡光，能直接告吗？
先问：有没有 负地役权（negative easement） 或写明的限制协议？
没有： 古老灯火原则已被抛弃，挡光不自动生权利
再看：有没有成文法或条例禁止该建筑？
本题：已获审批，且无适用法规 → 选 A：无诉因
结论：想要救济，先拿到权利；光凭“更暗了”不够。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：对方的新楼把你房子弄得更暗，租金也掉了，所以应该能拿到禁令或赔偿。

但考试真正问的是：你有没有先取得能限制对方合法建楼的 负地役权（negative easement）；没有的话，单纯“很受伤”不等于能赢。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的阴影有没有造成不舒服」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 A？

题干只有挡光和租金下降，没有 明确书面负地役权；在美国，Doctrine of Ancient Lights 早已失效，所以投资组没有可赢的诉因。

❌ 概念混淆 | 救济类型误判

✕ B: 把 mandatory injunction 当成挡光就能自动拿到的权利。

❌ 法律适用 | 赔偿路径误判

✕ C: 先假设已经有可执行权利，才会谈到按试到日赔损失。

❌ 事实误判 | 预设权利偷换

✕ D: 把 permanent damages 当成没拿到地役权也能直接要。

这题建议用什么方法？

先查权利来源，再谈救济；没有负地役权，就别被损失金额带跑。

考场速记

记住这句：挡光不是自动可诉，先问有没有 负地役权（negative easement）。没有书面约定，就先别急着找禁令或损害赔偿。

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
The owner of a five-acre parcel of land constructed a house on the land. The following year, the owner installed an underground drainage system on the land in order to prevent future flooding of his house.
Several years later, the owner gave one acre of the land in fee simple to his niece. The deed contained a provision in which the niece promised that she and her heirs and assigns would maintain the portion of the drainage system on her one acre. This deed was not recorded.
Five years later, the niece sold her one acre, in fee simple, at its fair market value to a buyer. Although the niece informed the buyer of her promise with regard to the drainage system, the deed by which the niece conveyed her property to the buyer did not mention this promise. The buyer promptly recorded this deed. Ten months later, there was a severe rainstorm. Because of the buyer's failure to maintain the drainage system, the owner's house flooded. The owner has sued the buyer for damages resulting from this failure.
A statute in the applicable jurisdiction provides, "No conveyance of an interest in real property shall be good against subsequent purchasers for value unless the same be first recorded according to law."
Should the court enforce the niece's promise against the buyer?

choices.A: No, because the deed by which the owner conveyed the one acre to his niece was not recorded.
choices.B: No, because the doctrine of estoppel by deed does not apply here.
choices.C: Yes, because both horizontal and vertical privity exist.
choices.D: Yes, because the buyer learned of the promise from the niece herself.

A real covenant is an express promise to do (affirmative) or not do (negative/restrictive) something on land enforceable by an action for damages. While the promising parties are bound by contract law, the covenant binds successors in interest only if it runs with the land. The elements required for a real covenant to run with the land are:

  • Writing: The covenant must satisfy the statute of frauds (e.g., the deed from the owner to his niece).
  • Intent to run: The promising parties intended for the covenant to run to successors (e.g., the deed says “heirs and assigns”).
  • Touch and concern: The covenant relates to the use, enjoyment, or occupation of the estates (e.g., maintaining a drainage system).
  • Horizontal privity: The promising parties simultaneously transferred the land and created the covenant (e.g., the covenant was created when a parcel was deeded).
  • Vertical privity: The successor of the burdened estate has the promising party’s entire estate (e.g., the buyer), OR the successor of the benefited estate has a possessory interest (Choice C).
  • Notice: The person to be bound had notice of the covenant (e.g., the buyer learned of the promise from the niece) (Choice D).

In this scenario, the covenant did run with the land, but the buyer is not subject to it because of the pure race jurisdiction. Under a pure race recording act, a real property interest cannot be enforced against a subsequent purchaser who recorded first. Since the buyer’s deed (which lacked the covenant) was recorded before the deed creating the covenant (from the owner to the niece), the promise is unenforceable against the buyer.

Note: An injunction to enforce a covenant is called an equitable servitude.

(Choice B) Estoppel by deed prevents a grantor from denying the effectiveness of a warranty deed that the grantor issued before the grantor actually owned the land. That doctrine does not apply here.

📌 Educational Objective

Under a race recording act, a real property interest cannot be enforced against a subsequent purchaser who records first.

📚 References
  • Restatement of Property §§ 530–38 (Am. Law Inst. 1944)
questions.zh-question:
一块五英亩土地的所有者在该土地上建造了一栋房屋。次年，为了防止房屋未来遭受洪水侵袭，该所有者在土地上安装了地下排水系统。

几年后，该所有者将其中一英亩的土地以fee simple（绝对所有权）的形式赠与了他的侄女。契据中包含一项条款，侄女承诺她及其继承人和受让人将维护其一英亩土地上的那部分排水系统。该契据未进行登记。

五年后，侄女以公平市价将其一英亩土地以fee simple（绝对所有权）的形式出售给一位买方。尽管侄女告知了买方她关于排水系统的承诺，但侄女转让其财产给买方的契据中并未提及此承诺。买方立即登记了该契据。十个月后，发生了一场特大暴雨。由于买方未能维护排水系统，导致所有者的房屋被淹。所有者已起诉买方，要求其赔偿因未履行维护义务而造成的损失。

适用法域的一项法规规定，“任何不动产权益的转让，除非首先依法登记，否则对有偿的后手购买人无效。”

法院是否应强制买方履行侄女的承诺？

zh-choices.A: 不应，因为所有者转让一英亩土地给其侄女的契据未进行登记。
zh-choices.B: 不应，因为estoppel by deed（契据禁止反言）原则在此不适用。
zh-choices.C: 应，因为同时存在横向和纵向的利害关系（privity）。
zh-choices.D: 应，因为买方从侄女本人处得知了该承诺。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Rights in Real Property - Covenants Running With The Land

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：地役/地役性契约式的 real covenant 虽然可能已经成立并且有 notice，但在 pure race recording act 下，先录的人还是能赢。

三秒认题路径：

契约会不会跑地上 → 先看是否可随土地转移 → 再看谁先录 → 先录买受人赢

核心法律规则

这题只要抓住的规则

real covenant 是“可以赔钱”的土地承诺；要想约束后手，必须满足 writing、intent to run、touch and concern、horizontal privity、vertical privity，通常还要有 notice，考场意思：不是只看“知不知道”，还要看它能不能真正跟着土地跑。

但这题还有录音法规则：pure race recording act 只看谁先录，先录的人即使后来知道了，也仍可能打掉后录的权益。考场意思：notice 不是万能钥匙，先录才是胜负手。

核心判例： Mohawk Industries v. Carpenter 不适用；本题真正锁定结论的是 race recording act 逻辑：先录的后手优先。

思维导图

先问：这条承诺能不能跟着土地跑？
YES： 写进契据 + 约定“heirs and assigns” + 维护排水系统，说明 real covenant 本来是能成立的。
再问： 买受人有没有 notice？有，妮姬直接告诉了他。
但卡死点： 真正决定输赢的是：买受人的契据先录了，而设立契约的旧契据没录。
结论： 在 pure race 下，先录的买受人拿下，原告不能靠这条承诺向后手索赔。
最终答案：A，因为没先录的原始设定契据打不过后录买受人。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：既然买家已经听妮姬说过这条承诺，那他就“知道了”，应该不能反悔。

但考试真正问的是：在 race recording act 里，谁先把相关权益录进去，先录的人就先赢；司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

所以别把 notice 当成终点，这题的终点是“先录”而不是“先知道”。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 A？

题干关键是原始设立契据 not recorded，而买受人先录了自己的契据；在 pure race 下，后录的承诺压不住先录的买受人。

❌ 概念混淆 | 规则渊源误判

✕ B: 把 estoppel by deed 硬套进来，题干根本不是“先出契据再补产权”的场景。

❌ 法律适用 | 中间上诉理由误判

✕ C: 看到 horizontal privity 就停住了，先录规则还没过关。

❌ 事实误判 | 题干条件偷换

✕ D: 买家听说过不等于能赢，learned of 不是本题的决定因素。

这题建议用什么方法？

先判“能不能跑”，再判“谁先录”，录音法优先级直接压过知情与 privity。

考场速记

记住：real covenant 先看“跑不跑”，再看“录没录”；在 pure race 里，先录的人优先。

口诀：In Certain Circumstances, An Appeal Can Be Made Prematurely 不是本题重点；本题重点是“先录先赢”，别被 notice 带跑。

question_analysis.skill_tested: apply race recording priority rule

reason.en: The maintenance covenant burdens use of the niece's acre for drainage protection.
reason.zh: 维护承诺使侄女地块承担排水相关的土地使用负担。

reason.en: Shows intent that the covenant run to successors in interest.
reason.zh: 表明双方意图使契诺对土地继受人发生效力。

reason.en: Under a pure race act, failure to record first defeats enforcement against a later recorded purchaser.
reason.zh: 在纯竞赛登记法下，未先登记将使该权益无法对抗后手已登记买受人。

label.zh: 受竞赛法保护的后续有偿买受人

reason.en: Identifies the class of buyers the recording statute protects when they record first.
reason.zh: 界定在先登记时受登记法规保护的后手有偿买受人。

reason.en: The buyer's prompt recording wins priority over the unrecorded owner-to-niece deed.
reason.zh: 买受人及时登记使其优先于未登记的原主至侄女契据。

keywords.text: maintain the portion of the drainage system
